description: Job Title: Data Extraction & Pipeline Engineer (m/f/d) – Web Scraping & Market Intelligence Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit develops intelligent data systems to observe, evaluate, and forecast market and sustainability developments across Europe. Our data pipelines extract and synthesize complex public, municipal, and real estate market indices into unified analytical models. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Backend & Data Extraction Engineer to design, deploy, and monitor scalable web crawlers, data scrapers, and data ingestion pipelines handling diverse, unstructured web sources. Key Responsibilities - Architect and maintain robust scraping and crawling pipelines targeting property portals, public registers, municipal gazettes, and economic data sources. - Implement parsing, data normalization, deduplication, and quality-validation routines for incoming raw data. - Manage proxy rotation, anti-bot mechanisms, rate limiting, and headless browser workflows. - Store and organize structured information using PostgreSQL, Redis, and document stores. - Package data services into Docker containers and interface them with internal analytics engines via REST/GraphQL APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology (e.g., FAST-NUCES, NED University, or equivalent). - Hands-on experience developing web scraping frameworks in Python: Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, or Puppeteer. - Practical knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/caching databases (Redis, MongoDB). - Experience with Linux environments, Docker, and Git. - Structured problem-solving mindset, persistence with complex web structures, and solid English skills. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Package: Excellent compensation package aligned with regional developer salaries. - Modern Workspace: Air-conditioned, reliable office in DHA Phase 1/2 with generator backup. - Local Leadership Path: Opportunities to scale into Engineering Lead / Data Operations Manager as the Karachi hub grows, supported by ongoing technical mentorship and European project workflows. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Top-performing engineers with consistent code quality and reliability over 3–6 months can transition to our research development institute in Germany under the § 18d researcher framework, complete with full visa sponsorship, relocation assistance, and housing / accommodation support. title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
description: Job Title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) – Satellite Analytics Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts research into sustainable land use, environmental resilience, and automated parcel due diligence. Our geospatial research unit develops automated analytical tools that leverage satellite imagery, open geodata, and topography models to assess real estate sites and environmental factors. Role Overview In this role, you will design and implement data pipelines to process multi-spectral satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEM), and municipal cadastral layers to evaluate site topography, ground sealing, and solar potential. Key Responsibilities - Build automated ETL pipelines to ingest and process satellite data (Copernicus/Sentinel, Landsat) and aerial imagery. - Process Digital Surface Models (DSM) and Digital Elevation Models (DEM) to calculate slope, terrain contouring, and building heights. - Match spatial parcel boundaries (ALKIS/OpenStreetMap) with satellite feature extractions using spatial databases. - Develop algorithmic scripts for rooftop solar potential calculation and environmental risk mapping (e.g., heat islands, flood zones). - Maintain spatial databases and expose analysis results via structured REST APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Surveying, GIS, Computer Science, or equivalent. - Strong programming skills in Python utilizing geospatial libraries: GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, GDAL/OGR, or PyProj. - Solid experience with QGIS and spatial relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). - Familiarity with satellite data platforms (Google Earth Engine, Copernicus Open Access Hub, or Sentinel Hub) is an advantage. - Good command of spoken and written English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary structure reflecting technical specialization. - Professional Equipment & Infrastructure: Modern workstation in DHA, Karachi, equipped with high-bandwidth connections and uninterrupted power supply. - Career Growth: Long-term advancement to Senior GIS Architect / Data Lead in Karachi, with access to collaborative international research projects, European geodata publications, and conference opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Candidates demonstrating outstanding analytical achievements over 3–6 months are eligible for our German research mobility track (§ 18d AufenthG), including dedicated relocation guidance and housing / accommodation support in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-geo@iris-institut.info

title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) (Computermathematiker/in)
description: Job Title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) – Real Estate Optimization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts scientific and applied research into algorithmic decision-making, automated site feasibility, and sustainable structural optimization. We combine spatial constraints, regulatory boundaries, and construction metrics to computationally model future-proof development scenarios. Role Overview As a Computational Algorithm Engineer, you will develop mathematical models and algorithmic scripts that simulate alternative building layouts, floor area ratios (BGF/BRI), and economic optimization scenarios for land parcels. Key Responsibilities - Develop computational logic to simulate building massing, setback constraints, and maximum buildable volumes based on parcel geometries. - Build mathematical evaluation models for multivariate scenario comparisons (e.g., Best-Case vs. Middle-Case commercial vs. mixed-use developments). - Interlink spatial building volumes with structured construction cost indices (German DIN 276 cost groups) to generate dynamic cost models. - Create parameter scripts and automated reporting outputs for feasibility analysis. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers, data engineers, and research directors. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree in Computational Design, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Engineering, or Architecture with an intensive programming focus. - Strong proficiency in Python, C#, or TypeScript; familiarity with computational geometry libraries or parametric modeling (Grasshopper/Rhino.Compute) is highly advantageous. - Solid mathematical foundations in optimization algorithms, geometry processing, and multivariate numerical analysis. - Ability to translate architectural planning regulations into structured code constraints. - Fluent written and verbal communication in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Compensation: Top-tier local remuneration reflecting algorithmic and computational expertise. - Modern Work Hub: Reliable, modern, air-conditioned workspace in DHA Karachi with high-speed fiber infrastructure and power backup. - Sustainable Career Track: Clear promotion tracks into Algorithm Lead or Scientific Computing Lead in Karachi, with ongoing exposure to European construction standards, research publications, and advanced modeling systems. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Outstanding candidates demonstrating mathematical rigor and successful delivery over 3–6 months can qualify for direct transfer to Germany as a Research Associate under § 18d AufenthG, including dedicated administrative assistance, visa handling, and housing / accommodation support on-site. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-ai@iris-institut.info

title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Bau (Bauinformatik))
description: Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
description: Job Title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) – Satellite Analytics Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts research into sustainable land use, environmental resilience, and automated parcel due diligence. Our geospatial research unit develops automated analytical tools that leverage satellite imagery, open geodata, and topography models to assess real estate sites and environmental factors. Role Overview In this role, you will design and implement data pipelines to process multi-spectral satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEM), and municipal cadastral layers to evaluate site topography, ground sealing, and solar potential. Key Responsibilities - Build automated ETL pipelines to ingest and process satellite data (Copernicus/Sentinel, Landsat) and aerial imagery. - Process Digital Surface Models (DSM) and Digital Elevation Models (DEM) to calculate slope, terrain contouring, and building heights. - Match spatial parcel boundaries (ALKIS/OpenStreetMap) with satellite feature extractions using spatial databases. - Develop algorithmic scripts for rooftop solar potential calculation and environmental risk mapping (e.g., heat islands, flood zones). - Maintain spatial databases and expose analysis results via structured REST APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Surveying, GIS, Computer Science, or equivalent. - Strong programming skills in Python utilizing geospatial libraries: GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, GDAL/OGR, or PyProj. - Solid experience with QGIS and spatial relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). - Familiarity with satellite data platforms (Google Earth Engine, Copernicus Open Access Hub, or Sentinel Hub) is an advantage. - Good command of spoken and written English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary structure reflecting technical specialization. - Professional Equipment & Infrastructure: Modern workstation in DHA, Karachi, equipped with high-bandwidth connections and uninterrupted power supply. - Career Growth: Long-term advancement to Senior GIS Architect / Data Lead in Karachi, with access to collaborative international research projects, European geodata publications, and conference opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Candidates demonstrating outstanding analytical achievements over 3–6 months are eligible for our German research mobility track (§ 18d AufenthG), including dedicated relocation guidance and housing / accommodation support in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

title: 3D Architectural Visualizer & Rendering Specialist (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Architektur)
description: Job Title: 3D Architectural Visualizer & Real Estate Rendering Specialist (m/f/d) Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-REND-02 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-REND-02 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is a German research institution operating at the intersection of architectural digitization, environmental resilience, and sustainable development. We combine engineering precision with visual storytelling to present sustainable development concepts, municipal renewal proposals, and investment pitches to decision-makers. Role Overview We are looking for a creative and technically skilled 3D Architectural Visualizer to translate 3D building models and mass studies into photorealistic imagery, architectural perspectives, and presentation-ready visual assets. Key Responsibilities - Produce photorealistic architectural exterior and interior renderings from BIM/CAD geometry (Revit, SketchUp, Rhino). - Set up realistic lighting, material texturing, vegetation, and context environments for urban and commercial real estate assets. - Create mass studies, conceptual 3D volumes, and interactive walkthroughs for project feasibility presentations. - Perform post-production image enhancements and color grading in Adobe Photoshop. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers and research leads to accurately reflect structural design intent. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Visualization, 3D Design, Animation, or related field (e.g., Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture, DUET, or comparable). - Proficiency in industry-standard visualization software: 3ds Max, Blender, Unreal Engine, Lumion, or Corona / V-Ray. - Strong aesthetic sense for architectural composition, atmospheric lighting, and material detailing. - A portfolio showing realistic architectural renderings is required for consideration. - Professional working proficiency in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package matching market rates. - Infrastructure: High-performance rendering hardware and reliable, air-conditioned studio space in DHA. - In-Country Career Growth: Rapid progression to Senior Visualizer or Art Director within our growing studio, with continuous training in real-time engines and computational visualization tools. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Exceptional performers proving dedication and high visual standard over 3–6 months can qualify for an international transfer to our research facilities in Germany (§ 18d AufenthG), fully supported with visa facilitation, relocation, and housing / accommodation support. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) (Architekt/in)
description: Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.info

title: Data Extraction & Pipeline Engineer (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
description: Job Title: Data Extraction & Pipeline Engineer (m/f/d) – Web Scraping & Market Intelligence Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit develops intelligent data systems to observe, evaluate, and forecast market and sustainability developments across Europe. Our data pipelines extract and synthesize complex public, municipal, and real estate market indices into unified analytical models. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Backend & Data Extraction Engineer to design, deploy, and monitor scalable web crawlers, data scrapers, and data ingestion pipelines handling diverse, unstructured web sources. description: Job Title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) – Real Estate Optimization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts scientific and applied research into algorithmic decision-making, automated site feasibility, and sustainable structural optimization. We combine spatial constraints, regulatory boundaries, and construction metrics to computationally model future-proof development scenarios. Role Overview As a Computational Algorithm Engineer, you will develop mathematical models and algorithmic scripts that simulate alternative building layouts, floor area ratios (BGF/BRI), and economic optimization scenarios for land parcels. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). title: Executive Souschef (m/w/d) (Koch/Köchin)
description: Deine Freunde wissen: Du bist ein Feinschmecker. Doch du bist noch viel mehr. Die gehobene Küche ist das, was dich Tag für Tag inspiriert und begeistert. Deine Liebe zum Detail lässt jedes Essen zum Erlebnis werden – immer und immer wieder. Zusammen mit einem Team passionierter Kochkünstler kreierst Du täglich etwas Neues. Du leitest hauptverantwortlich unser motiviertes Fang & Feld Team, entwirfst Menüs passend zur Saison und präsentierst Deine Gerichte auf einzigartig kreative Weise.So sieht Dein Tag aus- Sicherstellung des reibungslosen Küchenablaufes unseres Restaurants "Fang & Feld", sowohl operativ als auch administrativ- Leitung und Verantwortung für das 6-köpfige Küchenteam des Restaurants, sowie des Room Service- Förderung und stetige Weiterentwicklung eines attraktiven und kreativen Speisenangebotes des Restaurants und des Room Services- Unterstützung der Blick Bar, Bankettküche sowie unserer Mitarbeiterkantine- Motivation und Weiterentwicklung des Teams, sowie unserer Auszubildenden und Studenten- Durchführung von Mitarbeitergesprächen, sowie Erstellung von Entwicklungsplänen- Warendisposition und Kalkulation- Kontrolle eines optimalen Waren- und Materialeinsatzes sowie Planung und Überwachung der monatlichen Inventuren- Kommunikation und enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen- enge Kooperation mit Lieferanten zur Sicherstellung qualitativ hochwertiger Zutaten- Unterstützung bei der Herstellung und Zubereitung unseres Speisenangebotes- Verantwortung für die Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Hygienestandards- Vertretung des Executive Chef in dessen AbwesenheitDas wünschen wir uns von Dir- Du besitzt mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer gleichen oder ähnlichen Position in einem vergleichbaren Hotel oder Gastronomiebetrieb- Du besitzt ein hohes Maß an Belastbarkeit sowie Stressresistenz- Du bist ein Führungstalent mit sehr guten Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten- Du besitzt Kreativität und einen Sinn für Innovation- Du hast Kenntnisse im Bereich Kosten- und Qualitätsmanagement- Du besitzt sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse- Du pflegst einen sicheren Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-ProgrammenDu willst Spaß bei der Arbeit und das Leben genießen – auch da haben wir was für Dich:- Wir bieten den schönsten Arbeitsplatz Hamburgs - gelegen in der Elbphilharmonie, dem zurzeit gefragtesten Wahrzeichen Hamburgs inklusive atemberaubenden Blick auf den Hamburger Hafen.- Teamwork makes the dream work! Dich erwartet ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten.- Unser Management Team motiviert, beflügelt und informiert dich in unseren regelmäßigen Townhall Meetings.- Deine Karriere liegt uns am Herzen. Unsere regelmäßigen Beurteilungs- und Feedbackgespräche, sowie die individualisierten Entwicklungspläne helfen dir deine Karriereziele zu verwirklichen.- Fördern und fordern ist die Devise. Wir bieten dir zahlreiche Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten u.a. über unsere interne Lernplattform (Digital Learning Zone).- Wir haben immer ein offenes Ohr! Die Open-Door-Policy ist für uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit und wird tagtäglich von uns gelebt!- Kostenfreie Fitnesskurse in unserem Spabereich helfen dir deinen sportlichen Ausgleich zu schaffen. Zudem kannst du unsere Fitnessräume jederzeit kostenfrei nutzen!- Für dein leibliches Wohl ist gesorgt. Unsere hauseigene Kantine ‚Bootshaus‘ mit großzügigem Balkon und traumhaften Blick über die Elbe versorgt dich täglich mit kostenfreien, köstlichen und ausgewogenen Mahlzeiten.- Gut gekleidet durch den Tag. Du erhältst eine kostenfreie Uniform inklusive deren Reinigung.- Mit einer „Inhouse Experience“ erlebst du unser Hotel aus der Gastperspektive und genießt mit deiner Begleitperson eine Übernachtung mit einem Besuch in unserer BLICK Bar (oder Room Service) mit anschließendem Frühstück.- Du schlemmst auch privat gern? Du erhältst 40% Discount auf alle F&B-Leistungen im The Westin Hamburg, Renaissance Hamburg & Marriott Hamburg, sowie 20% bei allen anderen Marriott Hotels weltweit.- Confetti is always a good idea! Wir feiern gern und das gemeinsam mit dem gesamten Team bei unseren jährlichen Mitarbeiterpartys! Außerdem unterstützen wir die jährlichen Team Outings mit insgesamt 50,00 € netto pro Mitarbeiter.- Wir zelebrieren unsere ‚Hosts of the Month‘, sowie ‚Azubi/Dual Student & Leader of the Quarter‘ in unseren Townhall Meetings und dazu gibt‘s 100,00 € netto für jeden glücklichen Gewinner! - Es sind die kleinen Dinge im Leben… Geburtstagsgeschenke, sowie Präsente zur Geburt von Kindern, Hochzeiten und Jubiläen versüßen die besonderen Anlässe im Leben.- Reisen ist deine Leidenschaft? Wir ermöglichen dir vergünstigte Mitarbeiter-, sowie Family & Friends-Raten für Übernachtungen in mehr als 10.000 Marriott International Hotels weltweit.- Du shoppst gern online? Dann stöbere auf der Plattform ‚Corporate Benefits‘, um prozentuale Vergünstigungen auf zahlreiche Top-Marken zu erhalten.- Unser aller Wohl liegt uns am Herzen. Unser weltweites „Marriott Take Care“ Programm ermöglicht regelmäßige Workshops, Events, Trainings und Meetings zum Thema ‚Wellbeing‘ im Team und in unserer Community.- Deine Gesundheit ist uns wichtig – deshalb gibt es jährlich im Rahmen einer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung ein Gesundheitsbudget in Höhe von 300 € für dich zur freien Verfügung für Gesundheitsleistungen wie bspw. Medikamente, Brillen, Kontaktlinsen, Zahnreinigung, etc.

title: Import / Export & Supply Chain Specialist (m/f/d) - Korean & English (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
description: As an Import / Export & Supply Chain Specialist (m/f/d), you will drive the daily international trade activities and supply chain management for raw materials. You will act as the crucial link between global customers, freight forwarders, and internal departments, ensuring compliant, smooth, and efficient cross-border operations. This position offers a diverse range of tasks in a fast-paced, international setting.Your Responsibilities:- Managing internal sales, supply chain, and international trade operations for raw materials.- Handling end-to-end order processing, including trade contracts, import/export documentation, customs clearance coordination, AR/AP (SAP), inventory control, and logistics.- Overseeing international shipping, freight forwarding, and cross-border transport to ensure compliance with customs laws and trade regulations.- Monitoring credit limits, payment status, and trade terms (Incoterms) to minimize financial and operational risks.- Coordinating closely with international customers, freight forwarders, and customs agents to ensure seamless operations.- Optimizing import/export procedures and daily supply chain processes to increase operational efficiency.- Communicating effectively with key global stakeholders to build and maintain strong international business relationships.Your Profile:- Proven experience in internal operations, supply chain management, and international trade (Import/Export) in a global environment.- Completed commercial training, ideally as a Wholesale and Foreign Trade Merchant, industrial clerk, or comparable.- Solid practical expertise in international shipping rules, customs handling, and Incoterms.- Very good English and Korean language skills; German is a plus, but not mandatory.- Confident handling of an ERP system (ideally SAP SD/MM/GTS).- High resilience, strong customer orientation, and a proactive mindset in cross-border trade.- Fast learner with strong communication skills and a high level of intercultural competence.What We Offer:- Your personal development is important to us. We promise continuous development meetings and performance reviews to support your career path.- We guide and support our employees through a personal point of contact from our HR team at all times.- We offer exciting and challenging projects across the entire world of engineering, IT, and all business administration interfaces – within Germany's largest industrial sectors.- As a member company of the GVP, we stand for fair, transparent, and remuneration above the Wage Agreement. Our permanent employment contracts provide you with long-term security and perspective.- Our corporate culture is built on honesty, transparency, personal support, and reliability. We guarantee a partnership-based collaboration from day one.Who We Are:As an owner-managed family business, we are known for first-class services in technology and business administration. Our name, matchING, reflects what truly matters in technical industries: bringing together the right experts in Business Administration, Mechanical and Plant Engineering, the Automotive industry, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace, and IT to realize the goals of our candidates, employees, and customers.With over 10 years of expertise, we have in-depth knowledge of the industry and understand what satisfied and motivated employees truly value.Apply Now:Please apply directly via the application form in our job portal. Our recruiting team is happy to answer any questions regarding the position or the general application process.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

title: Business Development Senior Officer (d/f/m) (ECHO) (Business-Development-Manager/in)
description: IRC (International Rescue Committee) Germany is seeking aBusiness Development Senior Officer (d/f/m) (ECHO)- in Berlin / Bonn or Remote (within Germany) | ASAP |- full-time (40 hours/week) | Initially for 2 yearsAbout Us Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC offers lifesaving care and life-changing assistance to refugees forced to flee from war or disaster. In 2016, IRC Germany was founded and engages in global humanitarian work as well as throughout Germany in the areas of education, economic wellbeing, and safety, legal protection, and empowerment.The Crisis Response, Recovery and Development (CRRD) Department runs the IRC’s humanitarian, recovery, and development programs in five regions: West & Central Africa, East Africa, Middle East and North Africa, Asia, and Latin America. Within CRRD, the Award Management Unit (AMU)’s Grants Operations & Analytics Team (GOAT) supports pre- and post-award work for projects managed by Technical Excellence, Global Supply Chain and Airbel.  Major ResponsibilitiesThe Business Development Senior Officer (ECHO), will be responsible for leading a portfolio of business development opportunities, ensuring that all proposals are compelling and submitted in accordance with IRC and Donor policies.Business Development Process (80%)ECHO oversight: Provide IRC Germany oversight to opportunities submitted under ECHO’s Strategic Policies and Strategic Humanitarian Supply Chain HIPs. This will include completing ECHO pre-award checklists and uploads to APPEL. Proposal leadership: Outside of the ECHO HIP season, will serve as Proposal Lead for funding opportunities assigned by the Head of Business Development.- Lead the overall proposal development process to ensure submissions are compliant, responsive, and compelling. - Support the technical team to position for anticipated calls, including pre-development of concept notes.- Project manage proposals ensuring internal approvals in line with external submission deadlines- Coordinate with country programs and partners to collect the documents and inputs needed for each proposal Proposal Budget development: Serve as Budget Lead for funding opportunities assigned by the Head of Business Development.- Develop proposal budgets to ensure consistency and accuracy across projects. Design, draft, refine, and finalize budgets and budget narratives (as needed) that are reflective of program design costs.- Ensure appropriate internal formats and donor formats for budget development are used.- Coordinate and liaise with country program finance and grants staff on proposals, providing guidance and feedback on workplans, deadlines, and proposal parameters.- Secure approvals across departments for submissions.Process Support and Feedback (10%)BD Process Improvements: Work on departmental and organisational initiatives to improve IRC’s BD processes.- Support refinement of business development processes for Technical Excellence.- Attend key cross-unit and cross-departmental meetings regarding business development to maintain an in-depth understanding of IRC funding streams and business development priorities.ECHO Awards Management and Compliance (10%)Awards Management: Act as IRC Germany’s post-award focal point for Technical Excellence and Global Supply Chain ECHO awards. - Provide ad-hoc compliance guidance to grants team on ECHO awards- Coordinate with grants team to ensure timely submissions of reports on APPEL.- Monitor ECHO portfolio through participation in project implementation meetings, ensuring progress against objectives and compliance with ECHO guidelines.- Manage donor relationship with ECHO across portfolio.Your ProfileEssential- Experience preparing or submitting proposals to ECHO- 5+ years of progressive work experience connected to business development and working in or closely with Technical teams - Highly collaborative and pro-active colleague with a talent for delivering results with cross-functional groups- Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with organizational information and financial systems- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a multi-cultural environment - University degree in Business Administration, Finance, International Development or a relevant field, or equivalent work experience- You have English language skills at C1 and German B1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CERF) (https://www.europaeischer-referenzrahmen.de/)  Desired- Experience working with IRC systems is a plus- Dedication to diversity, equity and inclusion, and a strong passion for our mission- Comfortable adapting to new challenges and dynamic priorities, while maintaining professional grace - Fluency in French, Spanish or Arabic language a plus We Offer- Meaningful work within a collaborative team- A starting salary between 60,028 and 67,090 Euro gross per year as well as an annual salary increase- Attractive employee benefits such as gym membership, company pension scheme, shopping vouchers, childcare subsidy, job bike leasing, subsidized Deutschlandticket (national public transport), and access to timely and confidential psychological support if needed- 30 days of annual leave and special leave days- Flexible hybrid-work options (working hours, office/homebased)- Training and professional development opportunities, including access to free language courses- Assistance services for people with disabilities, if required.We look forward to receiving your application (including CV and – if available – three references) via our application portal (https://theirc.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Careers/job/Berlin-Germany/Business-Development-Senior-Officer--d-f-m---ECHO-_JR00005896) – even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. For questions regarding the position, please contact Burrhus Njanjo (HR.Deutschland@rescue.org (https://mailto:HR.Deutschland@rescue.org) ).As an organization committed to an empowering work environment, equal opportunities, and against any form of discrimination, we welcome applications from people regardless of their origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disabilities, age, or other characteristics protected by applicable law. We particularly encourage people with personal or family experience of flight and migration to apply.With equal qualifications, we give preference to applications from people with severe disabilities. If you have any questions about accessible applications or inclusion, please feel free to contact our Inclusion Officer, Christine Mader (christine.mader@rescue.org (https://mailto:christine.mader@rescue.org) ).To ensure equal opportunities, we kindly ask you to refrain from including photos in your application documents.Please submit your application by 29th November 2026.All IRC workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct (https://www.rescue.org/page/our-code-conduct) . On this basis, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding (https://www.rescue.org/page/safeguarding) , Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Anti-Retaliation.You can find more information about IRC Germany at IRCDeutschland.org (https://www.irc-deutschland.org/) .Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

title: Instandhalter (m/w/d) (Instandhaltungstechniker/in)
description: ZF is a global technology company supplying advanced mobility products and systems for passenger cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. Its comprehensive product range is primarily aimed at vehicle manufacturers, mobility providers and start-up companies in the fields of transportation and mobility. ZF electrifies a wide range of vehicle types. With its products, the company contributes to reducing emissions, protecting the climate as well as enhancing safe mobility.Alongside the automotive sector - passenger cars and commercial vehicles - ZF also serves market segments such as construction and agricultural machinery, wind power, marine propulsion, rail drives and test systems.With some 168,700 employees worldwide, ZF reported sales of €46.6 billion in fiscal year 2023. The company operates 162 production locations in 31 countries.Wir suchen einen Instandhalter (m/w/d) im Aftermarket für unseren Standort in #Schweinfurt.Unser Bereich Operations Engineering vereint die Kompetenzen aus unter anderem Elektronik und Mechatronik und besteht aus einem engagierten Team von 23 Mitarbeitenden. Wir arbeiten an Themen wie Verpackungs‑ und Fördertechnik sowie ersten Robotikanwendungen und setzen dabei auf enge Zusammenarbeit über alle Schichten hinweg. Alle Teammitglieder (m/w/d) übernehmen Verantwortung in der Schichtbetreuung und unterstützen sich gegenseitig - geprägt von einem harmonischen, hilfsbereiten Miteinander.Was Sie erwarten können als #Instandhalter (m/w/d):- Wartung, Reparatur und Durchführung von Fehlersuche und Störungsbeseitigung an Förderanlagen, Regalbediengeräten und Verpackungsmaschinen- Reparieren, Austauschen und Einstellen komplexer elektronischer und mechanischer Einheiten (z. B. Scanner, Umrichter, Etikettierer, Getriebe, PC‑Peripherie, Pneumatikkomponenten, Heißleimtechnik, Flurförderzeuge) unter Beachtung relevanter Betriebsanleitungen und Sicherheitsvorgaben- Analysieren von wiederkehrenden Störungen, sowie Planung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Optimierungsmaßnahmen an Anlagen und Maschinen- Erstellen und Pflegen von Plänen, Dokumentationen und Anleitungen unter Beachtung von Normen und technischen/betrieblichen Regelungen- Bestandspflege und Beschaffung von Ersatzteilen, Hilfsstoffen, Werkzeugen und Ausrüstung mittels EDV und Kommunikationsmedien unter Einhaltung vorgegebener Budgets- Mithilfe bis hin zu eigenverantwortlicher Leitung bei Umbauten und größeren Reparaturen im AufgabengebietWas wir von Ihnen erwarten als Instandhalter (m/w/d):- Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung - bevorzugt #Elektronik / #Mechatronik, alternativ #Mechanik- Erfahrung im Bereich der Fehlersuche und Reparatur von Maschinen und Anlagen von Vorteil, ebenso Kenntnisse in #S7 Steuerung- Erfahrung mit Förderanlagen, Regalbediengeräten sowie Verpackungsmaschinen wünschenswert- Höhentauglichkeit ist Voraussetzung- Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im #3-Schicht-Betrieb und Wochenendarbeit erforderlich- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse erforderlichWarum Sie sich für ZF in Schweinfurt entscheiden sollten:- Tarifvertrag- 30 Tage Urlaub- JobRad- Corporate Benefits- ZF@LearningEinstufung:Je nach ERA-TV für die Arbeitnehmer der Bayerischen Metall- und Elektroindustrie und je nach Erfüllung der oben aufgeführten Aufgaben und Anforderungen. Der Grundentgeltanspruch wird entsprechend der individuellen Vorkenntnisse ermittelt. Bei ZF ist die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben fest verankert. Weitere Informationen dazu finden Sie unter www.zf.com/berufundprivatleben. Wir leben den ZF WAY und fördern Diversität bei Stellenbesetzungen. Grundsätzlich kann die Stelle entsprechend in Vollzeit sowie gemäß TzBfG §7 mit zwei Teilzeitbeschäftigten (m/w/d) besetzt werden.

title: Leitung der Sozialen Betreuung (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description: Das AWO Soziale Kompetenz-Zentrum in Hilpoltstein ist ein modernes Zuhause für 107 Bewohner*innen, in dem Menschlichkeit, professionelle Pflege und eine offene Teamkultur Hand in Hand gehen. Zur Verstärkung unseres engagierten Teams suchen wirals Elternzeitvertretung zum 01. Februar 2027 eineLeitung der Sozialen Betreuung (m/w/d)in Voll- oder Teilzeit (38,5 Std. / Woche bei Vollzeit)Hier zeigen Sie Ihr Können:• Sie fördern und unterstützen unsere Bewohner bei der Teilhabe am gesellschaftlichen Leben• Darüber hinaus ermöglichen Sie eine individuelle und maßvolle Aktivierung wie z.B. Gesprächsgruppen, Freizeitangebote, Gedächtnistraining etc.• Ob es um die Erstellung personenzentrierter Hilfepläne oder um die individuelle Maßnahmenplanung geht – Sie halten den Kontakt und sind Ansprechpartnerin für unsere Bewohnerinnen• Auch die Führung des Teams der Sozialen Betreuung und das Erstellen von Dienstplänen gehört zu Ihren AufgabenDie Stelle ist zunächst auf 2 Jahre befristet. Wir streben eine Übernahme an (z.B. in eine geteilte Teilzeit-Führungsstelle oder eine ähnliche Position im Unternehmen)Damit bereichern Sie unser Team:• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Sozialpädagogik, Ergotherapie oder Ausbildung Gesundheits- und Krankenpflege, Altenpflege mit Zusatzqualifikation Fachkraft für Gerontopsychiatrie oder vergleichbare Qualifikation• Erfahrungshintergrund und Aufgeschlossenheit im Umgang mit pflegebedürftigen Menschen• Hohes Maß an Empathie, Einsatzbereitschaft, Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit• Personenzentrierte und dienstleistungsorientierte Arbeitshaltung• Sicherer Umgang mit EDV und MS-OfficeWarum Ihr Weg zu uns führen sollte:• Flexibilität & Familie: Genießen Sie flexible, familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten sowie ein Lebensarbeitszeitkonto – für die optimale Balance zwischen Beruf und Privatleben• Flache Hierarchien und Mitgestaltung: Wir reden nicht nur über flache Hierarchien – bei uns finden Sie vielfältige Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten und ein Umfeld, in welchem wir Ihre Vorschläge unter anderem im Rahmen unseres Ideenmanagements zu schätzen wissen• Mehr Erholung: 30 Tage Urlaub, freie Tage am 24. und 31. Dezember sowie bis zu zwei weitere Regenerationstage pro Jahr. Im Schichtdienst erfolgt ggf. ein Freizeitausgleich für den 24. und 31. Dezember an anderen Tagen.• Zusätzlicher Urlaub: Mit unserem neuen BGM-Bonusheft können Sie Punkte sammeln und sich attraktive Prämien sichern – wahlweise einen zusätzlichen Urlaubstag oder wertvolle Gutscheine• Attraktive Vergütung: Wir bieten eine tarifliche Bezahlung nach dem TV AWO Bayern, eine Jahressonderzahlung (85 %), vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberbeteiligung• Freuen Sie sich auf Extras, die sich auszahlen: Mitarbeiterbenefits, attraktive Prämien, Fahrradleasing u.v.m.• Herzliches Onboarding mit unserem Welcome-Day für neue Mitarbeitende und eine professionelle Einarbeitung in einem Team, bei dem kollegialer Zusammenhalt an erster Stelle steht• Individuelle Fort- und Weiterbildung: Profitieren Sie von maßgeschneiderten Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten in Form von Schulungen, Workshops und verschiedenen Programmen – gemeinsam gestalten wir Ihre berufliche Zukunft!• Wertschätzendes & vielfältiges Arbeitsklima: Erleben Sie ein starkes Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt – mit Offenheit, Respekt und einem wertschätzenden Miteinander. Bei uns zählt Vielfalt: Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und Hintergründe, die unser Team bereichern• Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Unser ausgezeichnetes betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement bietet Ihnen mobile Massagen, Obst, eine Wasserflatrate und vieles mehrBewerben Sie sich direkt online unterwww.awo-works.de/jobsKennziffer: *_000263Kontaktdaten:AWO Soziales Kompetenz-Zentrum HilpoltsteinStephanie VoigtSt.-Jakob-Straße 1291161 HilpoltsteinTelefon: 09174 474212E-Mail: s.voigt@awo-mfrs.de

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. Interested?📧 Apply by clicking the link to access the vacancy on JBT Marel´s website: https://jbtm.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/JBT_Marel_Career_Site/job/IS---Gardabaer/Information-Security-Officer--Junior-_25689.🌐 Learn more about us at: JBTMarel.com🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jbtmarel/Last application date is November 17, 2026. Join us - and help shape the future of maintenance excellence at JBT Marel.Use of Technology in Our Hiring ProcessJBT Marel uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support the review of applications.These tools help our recruiting teams identify skills and experience relevant to the role based on job-related criteria.All applications are reviewed by people, and AI is not used to make hiring decisions independently. We are committed to fair, consistent and inclusive hiring practices globally.

The ideal candidate will be a proactive and reliable professional responsible for maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and ensuring our guests have a wonderful start to their day.**Key Responsibilities:*** Performing comprehensive cleaning of guest rooms and public areas to ensure a comfortable and welcoming environment.* Managing all aspects of the daily breakfast service, including setting up and replenishing the buffet, and ensuring the dining area is clean and well-presented.* Handling the hotel's laundry services, including washing, drying, and folding linens.* Providing excellent customer service, assisting guests with inquiries, and processing payments for breakfast when required.**The Ideal Candidate:*** Has proven experience in housekeeping and/or food and beverage service.* Is fluent in English and possesses excellent communication skills. Proficiency in other languages is a strong asset.* Holds a valid B-category driver's license.* Is a dependable team player with a positive attitude and a strong work ethic.* Is flexible and willing to work a varied schedule.**What We Offer:*** A stable, full-time position in a friendly and dynamic work environment.* Competitive wages according to the collective bargaining agreement with the VLFS union.* **On-site accommodation is available for a fee.*** The opportunity to live and work in one of Iceland's most scenic areas.**How to Apply:**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.Interested parties are requested to send an application along with a CV to the email address: applications@ejhotels.isLast application date is November 15th , 2026.*****Starfsheiti:** Umsjónaraðili herbergja og morgunverðar**Staðsetning:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógum**Starfshlutfall:** Fullt starf**Starf hefst:** 15. nóvember 2026Hótel Skógafoss og Hótel Anna, staðsett í hinu fallega umhverfi Suðurlands, óska eftir að ráða þjónustulundaðan og fjölhæfan einstakling í fullt starf. Leitum að ábyrgum og traustum aðila sem hefur metnað til að viðhalda ýtrustu kröfum um hreinlæti og tryggja að gestir okkar fái frábæra byrjun á deginum.**Helstu verkefni og ábyrgðarsvið:*** Umfangsmikil þrif á herbergjum og sameiginlegum rýmum hótelsins til að tryggja snyrtilegt og notalegt umhverfi.* Fullnaðarumsjón með morgunverðarþjónustu, þ.m.t. undirbúningur og áfylling á hlaðborð.* Umsjón með þvotti hótelsins, s.s. þvottur, þurrkun og frágangur á líni.* Veita framúrskarandi þjónustu, aðstoða gesti og taka við greiðslum fyrir morgunverð þegar við á.**Hæfniskröfur:*** Sönnuð reynsla af þrifum og/eða störfum í veitingaþjónustu er skilyrði.* Mjög góð enskukunnátta og framúrskarandi samskiptahæfni. Kunnátta í öðrum tungumálum er mikill kostur.* Gilt ökuskírteini (B-flokkur) er skilyrði.* Áreiðanleiki, jákvæðni og hæfni til að vinna vel í hóp.* Sveigjanleiki og vilji til að vinna á breytilegum vöktum.**Það sem við bjóðum:*** Öruggt fullt starf á vinalegum og lifandi vinnustað.* Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi við VLFS.* **Húsnæði er í boði á staðnum gegn gjaldi.*** Einstakt tækifæri til að búa og starfa á einum fallegasta stað landsins.**Umsóknir:**Farið er yfir umsóknir jafnóðum.Áhugasamir vinsamlegast sendið umsókn ásamt ferilskrá á netfangið: applications@ejhotels.isUmsóknarfrestur er til og með 31.okt 2026.

title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Radiographers with mammography experience wanted in Iceland
description: Are you interested in working abroad while advancing your career within breast imaging and mammography? The department is committed to delivering high-quality patient care, patient safety, continuous improvement, and professional development.Period: 6–12 months, with start as soon as possible.Key Responsibilities    Perform mammography examinations in both screening and diagnostic breast imaging    Ensure patients receive a professional, caring, and sensitive service throughout the examination process    Travel to different locations across Iceland during parts of the year to perform mobile screening mammography    Maintain accurate documentation in the department’s information systems    Actively participate in quality improvement initiatives and the ongoing development of breast imaging services    Carry out specialized duties within the department as required    Contribute to the delivery of high-quality diagnostic imaging services    Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team to provide the highest standard of patient careWe Are Looking For    A licensed Radiographer.    At least two years of documented experience in mammography and breast imaging    Eligibility to obtain a professional license to practice in Iceland    Good English skills, both spoken and written    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a professional attitude    The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player    A reliable, structured, and proactive approach to work    Hold a valid license as a Radiographer from an EU/EEA country    A commitment to contributing to a positive and collaborative working environment    Flexibility and willingness to work in an international healthcare settingWe Offer    A rewarding position at Iceland’s leading university hospital    A comprehensive onboarding program and support from experienced colleagues    A positive and welcoming work environment with a strong team culture    Excellent opportunities for professional development and learning    Competitive salary conditions according to Icelandic collective agreements    Free accommodation throughout the assignment period    Paid round-trip travel at the beginning and end of the assignment    Assistance with obtaining Icelandic professional registration and authorization    Valuable international work experience in a highly specialized breast imaging departmentWhy Iceland?An assignment in Iceland offers you the unique opportunity to combine your professional career with the experience of living in one of the Nordic region’s most fascinating countries.Here, you will find dramatic volcanic
