title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Economics
description:
Job description

The Department of Economics invites applicants for a position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (SKO1352) in one of the following fields: Macroeconomics, Household Finance, or Family and Demographic Economics.

This is a full-time, four-year position, with 25% of working time devoted to teaching. The anticipated start date is between August 1 and October 1, 2027.

About the position 

The Department of Economics seeks a new colleague with the potential for outstanding research and high-quality teaching.

Candidates must provide evidence of excellence in research of the highest international caliber in macroeconomics, household finance, or family and demographic economics. This can be demonstrated by an innovative job market paper with a significant contribution to the literature, high-quality working papers, (forthcoming) publications in top-ranked and field-relevant journals, strong recommendations by referees who themselves have a record of excellence in research of the highest international caliber, the submitted research statement, presentations at significant conferences, and awards and accolades.

It is expected that the successful candidate contributes to a high standard of collegiality and the department’s working environment.

A postdoctoral position is intended for the employee to develop a research profile and competence that qualifies them to apply for an Associate Professor position. The position may also provide other competencies relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

About the project

The postdoctoral position is financed by the research project HOWFER (Housing, Wealth, and Fertility in High-income Societies), led by Associate Professor Martin Blomhoff Holm. The project combines macroeconomics, household finance, and family economics to analyze how rising house prices and wealth concentration have contributed to falling fertility in high-income countries. Using Norwegian administrative data linking wealth, housing, and family formation for the entire population, the work will estimate the causal effect of house prices on fertility and build structural models to evaluate which policies most effectively affect fertility. The postdoctoral researcher will contribute both to the empirical and theoretical parts of the project, in collaboration with the core research team.

Candidates should articulate how they can contribute to and strengthen the project.

Requirements
  • A PhD degree in Economics by the time of appointment, or shortly thereafter, and no later than September 30, 2027.
  • A strong research profile in Macroeconomics, Household Finance, or Family and Demographic Economics that complements that of the department and the research project.
  • Qualifications that are compatible with the department’s teaching obligations and study programmes.
  • Candidates must have fluent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Residence in or close to Oslo is required, and presence on campus is expected.
We offer 
  • Salary NOK 750 000 - 800 000 per annum, depending on qualifications, in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352).  From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • A stimulating and international research environment with multiple research groups and seminar series.
  • A friendly and inclusive workplace allowing for a good work-life balance.
  • Access to Norway’s excellent public services and welfare schemes, including generous parental leave provisions and affordable and accessible childcare (including the university’s kindergartens).
  • Norway’s capital, with its rich cultural life and easy access to beautiful nature.
  • Practical support for international staff moving to Norway (international staff may also benefit from tax cuts in their first years).
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interests, and how the candidate can contribute to and strengthen the HOWFER project).
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity).
  • Job market paper (clearly labeled).
  • Other working papers or publications.
  • Copies of PhD Diploma and educational certificates (academic transcripts only).
  • Letters of Recommendation (optional).
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). 

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

An interview will be part of the hiring process.

Contact information
  • Project leader: Associate Professor Martin Blomhoff Holm: m.b.holm@econ.uio.no 
  • Head of Administration (Office manager): Brita Langeid: brita.langeid@econ.uio.no 
We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. 

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We especially encourage women to apply.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Economics is the highest ranked institute for economic research in Norway and in the top group in the Nordic countries. The Department offers Bachelor's and Master's programmes, as well as a doctoral programme with approximately 20 students. The department has attracted a number of ERC grants, and it hosts both a center for public economics, Norwegian Fiscal Studies (NFS) and a center for international economics, the Norwegian Centre for International Economics, which will be established in the spring of 2026.

title: Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer
description:
Erithy, previously known as Be Better Contractors, specializes in the design and construction of sustainable subsea infrastructure globally.

We deliver consultancy services within the oil and gas industry, high voltage cables, biogas and hydrogen, as well as civil engineering services and project administration.

Created in 2017, Erithy has grown into a consultancy team made up of various profiles from Europe, South America and the Middle East, working on projects across Norway.

We are always on the lookout for new talented individuals to join our team, and we hope that you will be our new member!

We are now looking for a Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer for one of our customers based in Stavanger.

Duration: 12 months, with the possibility of extension. Start ASAP

Deadline for applications: 19.11.2026

Responsibilities:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer for a consultancy assignment of one year, with the possibility of adjustment, in the Asset Integrity & Maintenance Team for one of our operated offshore assets. In our operating model, the asset team is end-to-end accountable for technical and operational integrity, including barrier management, across all time horizons and in compliance with regulations and our management system. The discipline engineers in the team are multi-skilled, have close-to-full-time allocation to the asset, and are supported by the Portfolio Engineering team and subject matter experts for specialist and complex tasks. This is a senior role: the consultant will be expected to take full ownership of technical safety on the asset from day one, with minimal onboarding.

As Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer you will be the asset's day-to-day point of contact for technical safety. You are responsible for the technical safety equipment on the asset and the associated performance standards, and for ensuring that barriers are maintained, monitored and followed up in line with the risk picture. You will be followed up by the Technical Safety & Barrier Management department, which provides peer support and quality assurance.

  • Provide day-to-day technical safety support to the asset team and the offshore organisation.

  • Own and follow up technical safety equipment and associated performance standards (e.g. fire and gas detection, emergency shutdown, firewater and deluge, passive fire protection, ignition source control, escape, evacuation and lifesaving equipment).

  • Monitor barrier status, follow up degraded barriers and define robust compensating measures to maintain the safety level.

  • Assess risk related to deviations, dispensations, temporary changes and reduced functionality of equipment, and handle cases in the relevant tools (e.g. Synergi).

  • Follow up test and maintenance results for safety-critical equipment, including offshore participation in firewater and deluge tests, and contribute to performance standard compliance verification.

  • Provide technical safety input to management of change, modifications and work orders, and participate in or facilitate HAZID, HAZOP and design reviews.

  • Contribute to updates of risk analyses (TRA/QRA) and emergency preparedness analyses, and follow up resulting actions and assumptions in operation.

  • Interface with Portfolio Engineering, technical safety SMEs, barrier management advisors and other disciplines, and support audits and supervisory activities from the authorities.

Requirements:

  • MSc or BSc in engineering (e.g. safety, process, mechanical or similar).

  • Minimum 10 years of experience within technical safety, of which at least 5 years from technical safety in operations of offshore installations, preferably on the Norwegian continental shelf.

  • Good knowledge of the Norwegian regulations (Havtil) and relevant standards, e.g. NORSOK S-001, ISO 13702, IEC 61508/61511 and Offshore Norge Guideline 070.

  • Proven experience with barrier management in operation, including ownership of performance standards, follow-up of degraded barriers and definition of compensating measures.

  • Fluent in Norwegian and English, written and spoken.

  • Documented ability to work independently and take full ownership of technical safety for an operating asset from day one, without an extended onboarding period.

  • Valid offshore safety course and health certificate, or willingness to obtain them, and willingness to travel offshore.

Desirable experience:

  • Experience with risk-based deviation handling and management of change in an operator organisation.

  • Knowledge of NORSOK Z-013 and use of risk analysis results in decision-making.

  • Familiarity with SAP, Synergi and digital barrier status tools.

  • Experience from FPSO or production installations on the Norwegian continental shelf.

title: Rådgivar kliniske studiar (monitor/Clinical Research Associate)
description:
Vil du arbeide med kliniske studiar og løfte medisinsk forsking i sjukehusa? Vi søker etter ein engasjert og dyktig rådgivar innan kliniske studiar. Kliniske studiar er eit prioritert satsingsområde ved sjukehusa i Helse Vest, og det er eit auka behov for forskingsstøtte til fagmiljøa. Hos oss blir du ein sentral og verdifull samarbeidspartnar for fagmiljøa i regionen, og får ei nøkkelrolle i å rettleie og støtte forskarane gjennom heile prosjektløpet – frå planlegging og oppstart til trygg gjennomføring. Slik bidreg du direkte til at studiane held høg kvalitet og følgjer strenge nasjonale og internasjonale regelverk. Stillinga ligg til Seksjon for forsking og innovasjon (FoI) ved Forskings- og utviklingsavdelinga. FoI har ansvar for støtte- og rettleiingstenester innan forsking for alle sjukehusa i Helse Vest, og innan innovasjon for Haukeland universitetssjukehus. Seksjonen har ca. 55 medarbeidarar med høg kompetanse på ulike fagområde innan medisin, helsefag, kommunikasjon, jus, økonomi og forvaltning.  Vi søker personar med høg arbeidskapasitet, nøyaktigheit og fleksibilitet, som trivst med å handtere ulike og varierande oppgåver. Som Clinical Research Associate / monitor vil du ha ei viktig rolle i kvalitetskontrollen av kliniske studiar.  Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Monitorering og oppfølging av kliniske studiar i samsvar med ICH-GCP og standardiserte prosedyrar (SOP-ar), hovudsakleg ved Haukeland universitetssjukehus og dei andre sjukehusa i Helse Vest-området

  • Bidra til kontinuerleg forbetring og vidareutvikling av tenester og arbeidsprosessar for kliniske studiar, med særleg vekt på kvalitet
  • Handtere førespurnader om mogelege nye studiar frå industrien («feasibility»)
  • Delta i fagmiljø, nettverk og konferansar, samt halde faglege innlegg og opplæring

title: Vil du være med på å åpne en helt ny McDonald's restaurant i Stjørdal?
description:
Er du lei av ulike stereotypiske holdninger? Vil du jobbe et sted hvor du kan være deg selv og bli satt pris på akkurat slik DU er? Hos McDonald's vet vi at ulike mennesker gjør det best i team, hos oss kan du selvsagt være deg selv!

Hva kan du forvente hos oss?

  • God opplæring: Du trenger ikke å kunne alt fra dag én. Vi lærer deg å håndtere stress, jobbe i team og levere kundeservice med et smil (ja, selv på en hektisk fredagskveld)
  • God oppfølging: Du får tilbakemeldinger som hjelper deg å bli enda bedre – og skryt når du fortjener det
  • Rettferdig lønn: Vi følger de gjeldende lønnssatsene i Riksavtalen
  • Fleksible arbeidstider: Tilpasset deg og ditt behov
  • En meningsfull jobb: McDonald’s tar sosialt samfunnsansvar og jobber kontinuerlig med aktiviteter for en mer bærekraftig drift, som for eksempel at vi fjerner all plast fra emballasjen vår innen dette året
  • En arbeidsplass der alle får muligheten til å være seg selv: din personlighet betyr mer enn din CV
  • Fri når du har fri: Vi skjønner at du har et liv utenfor jobben

  • Du har sterke samarbeidsevner (teamwork er vår superkraft)
  • Du klarer å holde hodet kaldt under press (det er helt avgjørende når grillen streiker en fredagskveld)
  • Du elsker å lære og oppleve mestring (den følelsen du får når du klarer noe du trodde ikke var mulig)
  • Du er flink til å kommunisere og samarbeide, både med kollegaer og kunder (når det koker på kjøkkenet er din samarbeidsevne avgjørende)
  • Du trives med kundebehandling, matlaging, rydding og renhold (tiden går fort når du jobber hos oss)

Hos oss får du dette – og litt til.

Vi gir deg muligheten til å lære ferdigheter, som stressmestring, som ikke bare gir deg en fordel i arbeidslivet, men som også vil komme til nytte i livet ellers.

Er du klar for å bli en del av et team som setter pris på mangfold og individuell utvikling?

Vi er klare til å ønske deg velkommen – og muligens til og med dele en Big Mac!

Velkommen til McDonald’s!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hos McDonald's kan vi tilby deg en hektisk hverdag med mange nye utfordringer. Hos oss er ingen dager like og vi prøver til enhver tid å overgå gjestenes forventninger. Arbeidsoppgavene består av kundebehandling, matlaging og vasking/rydding av lokaler.

For å overgå gjestenes forventninger legger vi stort fokus på vennlig og rask servering, at vi respekterer og verdsetter hver enkelt gjest og at vi skaper gode opplevelser for kunder og hverandre

Hos oss får du lære deg å jobbe som et team med fokus på god kommunikasjon samtidig som du jobber selvstendig. Du får fantastiske utviklingsmuligheter, mange av våre franchisetakere og mange på hovedkontoret startet for eksempel opp som crew og jobbet seg oppover. Det er god opplæring med grundig oppfølging og i tillegg får du oppleve et fantastisk arbeidsmiljø og muligheten til å møte mange nye mennesker.

Les mer på www.mcdonalds.no eller følg oss på Facebook, Instagram og Twitter.

title: Technical Support & Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Specialist to bridge the gap between our Customer Care and DevOps teams. You will troubleshoot technical issues by connecting the dots between customer reports and multiple systems and forming a clear hypotheses.

Hva vi ser etter Qualifications

  • Practical understanding of web applications (SaaS), mobile app sync, and how software runs in production.

  • Comfortable using application telemetry, monitoring, or server logs to validate your hypotheses efficiently without getting lost in the data.

  • Strong communication skills in Norwegian and English, with a knack for explaining technical topics simply.

  • Experience from 2nd-line technical support, IT operations, or QA is an advantage.

  • Skilled at taking vague user symptoms, deducing the underlying conditions, and attempting to reproduce or isolate the failure domain systematically without needing direct code access.

  • Candidates must pass a pre-employment background check (bakgrunnssjekk ) and meet the conduct requirements (krav til vandel/politiattest) for aviation background checks (Luftfartstilsynet) and/or customer-mandated security clearances.

Who You Are

  • Curious: You look at a strange error and immediately start asking the right scoping questions: Is it tenant-specific or platform-wide? Is it a data issue, a module edge case, or a sync conflict? You enjoy testing your theories through clean replication, knowing exactly when to resolve it yourself and when to package a well-scoped ticket for escalation.

  • Pedagogical: You enjoy talking to users and teaching others how a system works.

  • Structured: You keep tickets tidy, respect security standards, and follow issues through to resolution.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Debug & Troubleshoot: Analyze customer tickets and server/application logs to pinpoint root causes and resolve issues directly.

  • Customer Dialogue: Support Norwegian and international aviation customers via phone, video, and email with a clear, service-minded approach.

  • Customer Training: Run onboarding and training sessions on the Opscom platform once you know the system inside out.

  • Team Relief: Offload routine operational tasks from Support and DevOps, and keep internal guides updated.

Vi tilbyr

  • A key operational role in an international aviation tech company headquartered at Bodø Airport.

  • Thorough product onboarding and close mentorship from experienced DevOps engineers and aviation specialists.

  • Career growth paths toward DevOps, technical customer success, or product management.

  • Competitive salary and a close-knit team environment.

title: Facility Director
description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Director, you will lead Nordscale’s Facility Management unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. You will be central in building the  unit ahead of and during the start of operations. You will hold overall responsibility for safe and stable operation of the facility, the buildings and the services around them, around the clock.

 

You will report to the Site Director and lead managers within quality, HSE, site coordination and logistics, sustainability and technical operations. 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Recruit and build the Facility Management unit, and prepare the organisation, procedures and suppliers for the start of operations in 2027.
  • Hold overall responsibility for safe, stable and efficient 24/7 operation of the facility. This includes building and site services such as property management, security, logistics, spare parts and sustainability.
  • Own the operational management system, including KPIs, meeting structure, reporting and follow-up. Build a strong safety and quality culture with strict operational discipline, and act as Incident Commander during major incidents.
  • Work closely with the Site Director, Nscale and IT teams. Manage supplier performance and budgets for maintenance, upgrades, energy and technical services. 

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

 You may be an experienced leader from data centres. You may also come from other technically complex, continuous operations where downtime has major consequences, such as process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, offshore, maritime operations, power or technical defence environments. Experience from establishing an operating organisation before a facility enters regular operation is an advantage. 

You are motivated by building something from the ground up, and you combine trust with clear follow-up. You know that following the standard and improving it are equally important parts of the same responsibility.

 

Key characteristics

  •  Structured and systematic, working with strong procedural discipline and attention to detail.
  • Resilient under pressure, identifying challenges and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.
  • Builds relationships of trust, collaboration and mutual respect, communicates clearly and listens actively.

 

Skills & Qualifications 

  •  Solid experience leading managers across several technical disciplines and support functions in 24/7 operations, together with subcontractors.
  • A strong track record in safety culture and HSE, including work and access permits, safe isolation, risk assessment and change management.
  • Experience with establishing and leading a performance management system, policies and procedures (SOPs etc) and supplier follow-up
  • Sound understanding of electrical, cooling and mechanical systems.
  • Experience from commissioning and start-up is an advantage.
  • Fluent English and a Scandinavian language, written and spoken. 
  • A master’s degree in electrical, mechanical or automation engineering is preferred. Other relevant technical education combined with documented operational experience will also be considered. 
What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The chance to build the operating organisation, procedures and safety culture from the ground up, and to lead Kvandal South into operation in 2027.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required.  
Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

title: Researcher
description:
About the position

A full-time researcher position (SKO 1109) is available at the Center for Lifespan Changes in Brain and Cognition (LCBC), Department of Psychology (PSI), Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Oslo. The researcher will work full time on the Horizon Europe project SHIELD - Sources of Health Inequalities from Environmental Pollution in Lifespan Brain Development, funded by the Horizon Europe programme. SHIELD investigates how environmental exposures affect brain health and brain diseases across the entire lifespan, from conception to old age. 

The position will focus on environmental exposure modelling and the generation of environmental exposure maps for the SHIELD cohorts, as well as MRI data analysis. We are particularly looking for a candidate who can work at the interface of brain imaging and environmental exposure data, with a strong research background in MRI data analysis and experience with using environmental and geographic databases. Transdisciplinary experience and interest will be an advantage, as the consortium involves partners from multiple fields, including (but not limited to) psychology, medicine, physics, environmental epidemiology and statistical modelling. 

As SHIELD is expected to generate significant impacts, the researcher will be expected also to contribute to stakeholder engagement and science communication activities, for example by participating in stakeholder workshops and contributing to policy briefs, newsletters, and social media posts. 

The research position is funded until the end of the project, 31 December 2031. LCBC is the coordinator of the SHIELD consortium, which includes 13 partners, and this position will be one of the key roles in the entire consortium. The position and its associated tasks are funded only for the stated period and will end when the funding period expires.

More about the position and the research center

The goal of LCBC is to understand differences and changes in brain and cognition across the entire lifespan, and to identify how brain function and cognition can be optimized. LCBC is an active, multidisciplinary research center with around 25 full-time staff members, including four professors, two researchers, several postdoctoral fellows and PhD candidates, chief and senior data engineers, full- and part-time research assistants, administrative support, and several affiliated international researchers. 

LCBC has excellent research infrastructure, including access to a 3T Siemens Prisma MRI scanner, PET and EEG facilities, and comprehensive neuropsychological and somatic testing facilities. English is the main working language at the center.

LCBC has secured several large grants, including four European Research Council (ERC) grants, a Horizon 2020 grant, and several grants from the Research Council of Norway, the National Health Association of Norway, and the University of Oslo. In 2015, the group was designated “world-leading” and is one of only five such groups at the University of Oslo. More information is available on the LCBC website: https://www.lcbc.uio.no. 

Your main tasks will be
  • Processing and analyzing multimodal brain MRI (structural, diffusion, and quantitative imaging) and cognitive trajectory and modeling these in relation to exposures. 
  • Processing and analyzing behavioral and health data and modeling these in relation to brain and exposure data. 
  • Characterizing and modelling historical air pollution concentrations (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, etc.) for the SHIELD cohorts by integrating Chemical Transport Model (CTM) simulation outputs with emission inventories and observational datasets. 
  • Generating environmental exposure maps extending back to 1920 by combining diverse open-source datasets (meteorological, emissions, and land-use data) for SHIELD's Age-Period-Cohort (APC)-corrected analyses.
  • Contribute to harmonization, expansion and application of EXPANSE maps. 
  • Collaborate with other SHIELD researchers and participate in the SHIELD consortium meetings. 
  • Write and publish scientific articles. 
  • Contribute to stakeholder engagement and science communication activities of SHIELD: participating at workshops, writing policy-briefs, newsletters, social media posts etc.
Qualifications

In this role you must have 

  • PhD in a relevant field such as Neuroscience, Meteorology, Physics, Biophysics, Complex systems, Data Modelling, or a highly related, quantitative natural science/interdisciplinary field. 
  • Research experience in Computational Neuroimaging analysis (structural, functional, diffusion, or quantitative MRI). 
  • Experience with the use of meteorological/climate, spatial, or similar multidimensional databases. 
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R. 
  • Very good proficiency in written and spoken English is a prerequisite.

It is an advantage if you have

  • Experience with secure computing and data-handling environments suitable for sensitive human cohort data. 
  • Experience with research in interdisciplinary/transdisciplinary research environments. 
  • Experience in science communication and outreach activities.
Personal qualities

In the evaluation of applicants, emphasis will be placed on the following personal skills: 

  • Cooperation skills, and the ability to successfully join an international academic collaboration. 
  • Professional and personal ability to work independently.   

In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed upon the quality of the candidate's academic qualifications. Interviews with selected candidates will be arranged where the applicant's prerequisites, interest in and motivation for the field of research, and cooperative skills will be assessed. 

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 

We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed, highly competent colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK 720 000 - 820 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

Planned start date: 1st April 2027.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Letter of application, 1-2 pages, explaining the motivation for applying.
  • Curriculum Vitae summarizing education, positions, and academic work.

title: PhD Fellow in Evolutionary Biochemistry
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

A 4-year PhD position in Evolutionary Biochemistry is available at the Department of Medical Biology, Faculty of Health Sciences, within the Host–Microbe Interaction (HMI) research group. The position is part of the LacZymes project, led by Dr. Christopher Frøhlich.

General information about the position.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD programme is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25 % each year and will consist of teaching and other duties. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

The project 

Do you hold a Master’s degree in molecular biology (or a related field) and have a strong interest in the molecular mechanisms underlying antibiotic resistance development? Are you motivated to conduct interdisciplinary research at one of the northernmost universities in the world? If so, this PhD position may be of interest to you.

The successful candidate will join a project aiming to uncover the molecular mechanisms of AMR evolution at the enzymatic level. To address this, the project integrates ancestral sequence reconstruction, directed evolution, pre-steady-state and steady-state enzyme kinetics, and X-ray crystallography. Candidates with experience in one or more of these areas are encouraged to apply.

The PhD candidate will report to Dr. Christopher Frøhlich and is expected to contribute actively to the project while developing expertise at the interface of molecular biology, enzymology, and evolutionary biology.

The PhD candidate will work on the following tasks: 

  • Manage their own research project
  • Experimental design and execution
  • Enzyme evolution and selection
  • Enzyme production and purification
  • Biochemical enzyme characterization
  • Structural and functional characterization
  • Writing scientific papers and a PhD thesis
  • Presenting the work in national and international arenas

Personal characteristics:The applicant should be motivated, creative and ambitious, with a strong ability to work problem-solution orientated both in teams and independently. The applicant should be genuinely interested in the field of molecular evolution and AMR as well as scientific dissemination. In the evaluation of which applicant is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience, and personal suitability, in terms of the qualification requirements specified in this position announcement. The appointment is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants and national guidelines for appointment as PhD fellow

Applicants are required to submit a motivation letter describing how the position aligns with their research interests.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Christopher Frøhlich:

  • phone: +47 46 96 87 78
  • email: christopher.frohlich@uit.no
Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Master’s degree in molecular biology, microbiology, chemistry or equivalent education, with a grade of C or better. Candidates who have not yet completed their Master’s education must submit a written statement from their main supervisor stating the tentative date of their Master’s defence.
  • Experience in at least two of the following areas: molecular cloning, protein expression and purification, biochemical characterization of enzymes (e.g. kinetic investigations), X-ray crystallography
  • Documented oral and written English skills

Applicants must document fluency of in English and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.  Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language is also beneficial.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in the field of AMR and AMR mechanisms
  • Experience in coding (e.g. Python) and competence with computer-based analytical tools (e.g., Pymol)
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language
  • Experience in writing publications
  • Experience in a biosafety level-2 laboratory environment

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. (The motivation letter will also be considered.) In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good collaboration skills
  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Wants to contribute to a good working environment

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.

Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Health Sciences and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

 

Applicants must have a grade of C or better on the master's thesis and have a grade point average of C or better for the master's degree. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.

Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.

We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility

Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • A motivation letter describing how this position aligns with the applicant’s research interests.
  • CV, including a list of publications, if applicable. 
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Two references with contact information

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 

Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 

General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure.

Vi er 6 ansatte som arbeider med utleie, drift, forvaltning og vedlikehold av våre eiendommer.Som daglig leder får du en sentral rolle i en liten organisasjon, med korte beslutningsveier og stor mulighet til å påvirke hvordan vi utvikler og tar vare på eiendommene våre.Dine viktigste oppgaverSom daglig leder vil du ha det overordnede ansvaret for den daglige driften av stiftinga.   • Ledelse og oppfølging av medarbeidere

  • Bidra til videre utvikling av stiftinga og eiendomsporteføljen
  • Tett samarbeid med styret
Hvem ser vi etter?Vi ønsker oss en daglig leder som kombinerer ledererfaring med teknisk forståelse. Relevant teknisk utdanning eller erfaring fra bygg, eiendom, drift, vedlikehold eller tilsvarende vil være en klar fordel.Du bør være strukturert og selvstendig, samtidig som du trives med å arbeide tett sammen med både ansatte, styret, kunder og samarbeidspartnere.Vi legger særlig vekt på at du:
  • Har relevant ledererfaring
  • Har god teknisk forståelse, gjerne innen bygg og eiendom
  • Har økonomisk forståelse og evne til å styre etter budsjett
  • Er løsningsorientert og har god gjennomføringsevne

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.Vi tilbyrHos oss får du en selvstendig og variert lederstilling med stor påvirkningsmulighet og ansvar for en betydelig eiendomsmasse.Vi tilbyr blant annet:
  • En interessant lederstilling med stor grad av selvstendighet

Interessert?Dersom du ønsker en lederstilling der du får kombinere ledelse, økonomi, eiendomsforvaltning og tekniske fag, ønsker vi gjerne å høre fra deg.Arbeidssted: Høyanger Stilling: Daglig leder – 100 % fast stilling Søknadsfrist: 04.12.26For nærmere informasjon om stillingen, kontakt styreleder Frode Øren, telefon 40 40 18 62.Søknad med CV sendes til: frode.oren@hoyanger-trelast.no via "søk på stilling" knappen på denne siden.Høyanger Bustadstifting – vi skaper gode rammer gjennom langsiktig og ansvarlig forvaltning av våre eiendommer.

title: Legal, Risk & Compliance Officer
description:
ZTL Payment Solution | Oslo, Norway

Help shape the future of B2B payments while building trust, sound governance and responsible growth.

About ZTL Payment Solution

ZTL is a pioneering Fintech company revolutionizing B2B payments by leveraging the Open Banking initiative and PSD2 regulations. Our innovative platform integrates seamlessly with ERP Accounting Systems, enabling SMEs to execute domestic and international invoice payments efficiently while accessing real-time balances and transaction data. With PSD2 licenses for Payment Initiation and Account Information, plus a money-transfer license from the Norwegian Financial Supervisory Authority, we are poised to become the leading B2B payment platform in the Nordics and beyond. Join us to shape the future of payments with a dynamic, entrepreneurial team.

The opportunity

We are looking for a pragmatic and commercially minded Legal, Risk & Compliance Officer to help ZTL scale responsibly across the Nordics and Europe. You will be a trusted adviser to colleagues across the business, translate complex regulatory requirements into practical solutions, and strengthen our risk and compliance framework without slowing innovation. This is a broad, hands-on role with visibility across management, product, technology, operations and external partners.

What you will do

  • Provide clear, solution-oriented legal advice on payment services, commercial agreements, partnerships, products and regulatory matters; coordinate external counsel where appropriate.

  • Monitor and interpret relevant Norwegian and EU requirements, including PSD2/payment services regulation, AML/CTF, sanctions, data protection and DORA; assess impacts and coordinate implementation.

  • Maintain and improve ZTL’s compliance programme, policies, procedures, controls and regulatory obligations register, applying a proportionate, risk-based approach.

  • Coordinate enterprise and operational risk assessments, risk appetite and control follow-up; maintain actionable risk and issue reporting for management and the Board.

  • Plan and perform independent compliance monitoring, thematic reviews and control testing; document findings, agree remediation actions and track them to closure.

  • Support regulatory reporting, supervisory dialogue, inspections and responses to Finanstilsynet, in collaboration with relevant accountable functions.

  • Partner with technology, security and operations on ICT third-party risk, incident management, business continuity, operational resilience and changes to products and processes.

  • Advise on customer and partner due diligence, financial crime controls and safeguarding-related governance, working closely with the designated AML and operational owners.

  • Draft and negotiate contracts, assess new markets and partnerships, and help embed compliance-by-design into product development.

  • Build awareness through concise training, practical guidance and constructive challenge; foster a culture of integrity, ownership and sound decision-making.

What you bring

  • A degree in law (Master of Laws / cand.jur. or equivalent) is preferred; a relevant higher degree combined with strong legal and regulatory experience may also be considered.

  • Relevant experience in legal, risk or compliance roles within regulated financial services, payments, banking or Fintech.

  • Working knowledge of Norwegian and EU financial-services regulation, with the ability to navigate complex requirements and explain them simply.

  • Experience with risk assessments, compliance monitoring, policy frameworks, governance and/or commercial contract work.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a Scandinavian language and English; strong judgement, integrity and attention to detail.

  • A collaborative, self-directed approach: comfortable prioritising, challenging constructively and turning advice into workable action.

Why join ZTL?

  • Meaningful influence on how a regulated Fintech scale-up builds its next phase of products and partnerships.

  • Close collaboration with decision-makers and a talented, entrepreneurial team.

  • A varied role combining strategic judgement with practical execution, professional development and real ownership.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, and an open, inclusive working environment.

Interested?

We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives. If you meet many, but not all, of the criteria and are excited about our mission, we encourage you to apply. Learn more at www.ztlpay.io. Any background or suitability checks will be proportionate to the role and carried out in accordance with applicable requirements.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

ZTL is a challenger to the banks' "Transactional Services". We're a cloud-native SaaS hybrid B2B payment company in the early expansion phase. We integrate our Open Banking APIs into various ERPs and API platforms to build new business models within payment services. Drop us an email if you want to explore opportunities.

title: Head of Partnerships
description:
About Six Robotics

At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible.

From our base in Oslo, our team of 90+ engineers, researchers, and defence specialists develops our autonomy and swarm platform, used by both government and industry. Working closely with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI) and end users, we move quickly from ideas to field deployment, solving problems where software meets the real world.

The challenges we work on don’t come with existing playbooks. They demand deep technical thinking, close collaboration across disciplines, and the ability to learn quickly as both the technology and the company evolve.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. If you’re excited about building systems that matter and growing alongside talented people that push boundaries every day, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact.

About the role

Six Robotics is a software-first company. We deliver autonomy and swarm software that runs on someone else's hardware, which means we rarely reach the end user alone. Some customers we contract with directly. Others we reach through a prime contractor, and others through an OEM that integrates our software into its platform. Each route has different economics, different responsibilities, and different expectations of us. As we scale internationally, how well we work with partners will shape how far and how fast our software reaches the field.

We are looking for a Head of Partnerships to own this part of the commercial organisation. You will be responsible for building and managing strategic partnerships with OEMs, primes, and other ecosystem players, in a way that creates lasting value for both parties. This is a senior role for someone who sees a partner relationship as a commercial engine to be designed, not just a contact to be maintained.

Your first and most important task is to build the framework for how Six Robotics works with partners. That means defining how we go to market together, how we co-sell, how we co-deliver, and how we co-price: who leads, who owns the customer, how value and risk are shared, and what each side commits to. You will turn what is today a set of individual relationships and one-off arrangements into a clear, repeatable model that colleagues and partners can both understand and work from. You will then take ownership of running it, from selecting the right partners to managing the relationships day to day.

You will work closely with our Strategic Account Executive, Business Developer, and leadership team, and with product, engineering, delivery, legal, and security. You will be the person who ensures that when a pursuit runs through an OEM or a prime, our position, our pricing logic, and our delivery commitments hold together. We have not yet fixed how partnership success will be measured. Defining the right metrics, together with leadership, is part of the job.

This is a “Head of” role, but also a founding one. There are no partner managers today, so for the first phase you will carry existing partner relationships yourself – while building the framework around that work and scaling the function as the pipeline justifies it. You will be

both the head of partnerships and the first partner manager, and we want someone energised by that combination. You will have real freedom to shape the approach, and real accountability for the results. Formal targets and incentive structures will be developed as the function matures.

Success after six months looks like a clear partnership strategy with defined partner categories and priorities; a first version of the framework for go-to-market, co-selling, co-delivery, and co-pricing, agreed with leadership and tested in live opportunities; active, trusted relationships with our priority OEM and prime partners; and an agreed way of measuring partnership performance. Colleagues and partners alike will see you as the person who makes working with Six Robotics easy and worthwhile.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and own the partnership strategy: which partners matter, in which markets and segments, and what role each plays in how Six Robotics reaches customers

  • Design the partner operating framework, covering go-to-market, co-selling, co-delivery, co-pricing, and the commercial and contractual principles behind each

  • Define partner categories and engagement models, including OEM integration, prime contractor teaming, and direct-with-end-customer arrangements, and set out when each route is the right one

  • Act as the day-to-day partner manager for existing priority partners until the function is staffed: joint planning, pipeline reviews, escalations, and follow-through

  • Lead negotiation of partnership agreements, teaming arrangements, licensing and revenue-sharing models, and other commercial terms, working with legal and finance

  • Align product, engineering, and delivery with partners on integration, support, and delivery responsibilities, so that what we commit to together can be delivered

  • Propose and agree with leadership how partnership performance is measured, and report on pipeline influenced, partner health, and risks

  • Scale the function: define the roles, hiring plan, and ways of working for a partner team, and build and lead it as partner volume and revenue justify the investment

What we are looking for

We're looking for a commercially sharp, mission-driven partnership leader who has built and run strategic partnerships that produced real revenue. You combine the judgement of a senior deal-maker with the patience and diplomacy that long defence and industrial relationships require. You understand that a good partnership is one where both sides win, and you know how to structure it so they do.

You are comfortable building the model rather than inheriting one. Instead of waiting for a playbook, you create the structure, make sound decisions, and bring colleagues and partners along. You are energised by time with partners and customers, and should expect to travel regularly, to build the relationships that matter.

Must-have qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, alliances, or strategic sales in B2B technology, defence, aerospace, or another complex regulated environment

  • A track record of building strategic partnerships with OEMs, primes, system integrators, or similar partners, and of turning them into measurable commercial outcomes

  • Experience designing partner frameworks or programmes, including go-to-market models, co-selling, co-delivery, and pricing and revenue-sharing structures

  • Strong commercial and contractual judgement, including negotiating teaming agreements, licensing, and complex multi-party deals

  • Experience working with multi-party defence or industrial procurement, where the customer, the prime, and the technology supplier all have a stake in the outcome

  • Ability to influence and align senior stakeholders, both externally at partners and internally across product, engineering, delivery, legal, and leadership

  • An established network in relevant defence and industry circles, or the ability to build trusted senior relationships quickly

The Persona we are looking for:

  • Intrinsically motivated, resilient, and accountable; you take ownership of outcomes and find a way through obstacles

  • A builder who can bring structure, clarity, and pace to an area that is still taking shape

  • A trusted counterpart who is credible with partner executives and engineers alike, and who can hold a firm position while keeping the relationship strong

  • Able to influence without authority and to see a deal from both sides of the table

  • Motivated to join a fast-paced scale-up, take ownership of a strategically important function, and build something from an early stage

  • Comfortable being both strategist and operator: equally at home designing the model and doing the partner work yourself, without seeing either as beneath the role

Nice-to-have:

  • A background in the military, including officer training or equivalent, is a strong plus

  • Experience with NATO, Nordic, or major European defence markets, primes, and procurement environments

  • Experience working with or at an OEM, drone or unmanned systems manufacturer, or defence prime

  • Experience with software licensing or platform business models, or with selling software that runs on a partner's hardware

  • Experience selling or partnering around autonomy, robotics, AI, or other technically sophisticated capabilities

  • An academic background is not a requirement, but may be beneficial. In this industry, experience, judgement, and credibility outweigh formal education

Personal fit matters just as much as the CV. We're looking for a specific type of person. Someone with the right instincts, credibility, and presence to operate in this environment, so personal suitability will weigh heavily in our assessment.

Why You Should Join

  • Build at the edge of what’s possible: You’ll work on problems the industry hasn’t solved yet, alongside people who are pushing the boundaries of autonomy, AI, and robotics.

  • Grow as fast as the company: We believe that chance favours those in motion. The role you’re hired into is just the starting point. As Six Robotics evolves, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your opportunities.

  • Work with exceptional people: Surround yourself with people who raise your own standards. You’ll join a team of ambitious engineers and operators who care deeply about the quality of their work. Expectations are high, but so is the willingness to help each other improve.

  • Ship work that matters. The things you build don't stay in a demo environment. They get deployed, tested, and used where reliability and performance genuinely matter.

  • Supported by great benefits. Alongside meaningful work, we offer competitive compensation, strong pension and insurance plans, gadget budgets, modern equipment, panoramic offices, and the flexibility you need to do your best work.

Our Recruitment Process

We want hiring to be transparent and respectful of your time. We aim to move with momentum while making thoughtful hiring decisions - because every new team member matters.

Our process typically includes:

  • Initial phone screening (30 min): A conversation about your background, motivation, and the role.

  • First interview (45 min): Meet the hiring team, learn more about Six Robotics, and discuss your experience.

  • Second interview (60–90 min): A technical discussion, typically including a take-home assignment or case presentation.

  • Final interview (45 min): Meet members of our leadership team to align expectations and answer any remaining questions.

Reference checks are conducted before an offer is finalized. We review applications continuously, so don't leave us hanging. Send us your application today!

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.

Security Clearance Requirement

All employees at Six Robotics must be eligible for security clearance. Some roles might require a high level of clearance, depending on the nature of the work. If you are hired, we’ll guide you through any required authorization or clearance process as part of your onboarding. Previous authorization or clearance is not required, but all candidates must be eligible to obtain the necessary approvals if required for their role.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations. We overcome the limits of current systems with collaborative swarm autonomy, enabling unmanned systems to act as one. Our software lets drones collaborate, adapt, and execute missions as a team, allowing a single operator to control an army of robots, accelerate decisions, and multiply combat effectiveness.

title: Kontaktperson
description:
Barneverntjenesten for enslige mindreårige flyktninger (EMF), er en av de byomfattende tjenestene i Etat for barn og Familie. Tjenesten har ansvar for å bosette og følge opp alle enslige mindreårige flyktninger som får tildelt Bergen som sin bosettingskommune. Barneverntjenesten har en egen kontaktpersonavdeling, og driver i tillegg selv en rekke ulike bo- og omsorgstiltak for EMF. Vi har egne kommunale barneverninstitusjoner, ulike typer bofellesskap, og en egen etterverntjeneste som følger opp voksen ungdom som bor på hybel og i vertsfamilier.

Tiltakene er plassert mange ulike steder i byen, men administrasjonen og kontaktpersonavdelingen som nå har en ledig stilling, holder til i Bredalsmarken 15

Vi søker etter en ny engasjert medarbeider, som brenner for å bidra til at den enkelte enslige mindreårige får gode muligheter til å integrere seg og trives i sin nye by Bergen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Kontaktpersonene driver saksbehandling etter lov om barneverntjenester, og har det faglige ansvaret for utredning og koordinering av kommunens oppfølging av den enkelte enslige mindreårige.

Dette innebærer mellom annet:

  • Samtaleoppfølging og samarbeid med den enslige mindreårige 
  • Ansvar for undersøkelsesplaner, utredningsarbeid, forberede vedtak, og holde frister etter barnevernloven
  • Lage, følger opp og evaluere tiltaksplaner og omsorgsplaner
  • Følge opp og evaluere fosterhjem
  • Klargjøre saker for oppfølging og avslutning
  • Økonomiforhandlinger ved tiltaksetablering, samt ansvar og kontroll av generell økonomi i enkeltsakene
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid både internt og eksternt
  Kvalifikasjoner
  • Det kreves mastergrad i barnevern. Søkere med annen relevant mastergrad kan bli vurdert, forutsatt at de har relevant arbeidserfaring innen fagområdet.
  • Det er et krav at man har erfaring med arbeid med barn og unge, og at man har erfaring med arbeid med etniske minoriteter og integrering.
  • Det stilles krav om erfaring som kontaktperson fra barneverntjenestens førstelinje.
  • Gode ferdigheter innenfor bruk av IKT/digitale systemer er et krav.
  • Ønskelig at du har erfaring med Modulus Barn.
  • Det er ønskelig med bred yrkesmessig erfaring innenfor relevante fagfelt, som barnevern og psykisk helse for barn og unge.
  • Gode ferdigheter når det gjelder å formidle og systematisere kunnskap.
  • Ønskelig med kompetanse på TBO (traumebevisst tilnærming).
Personlige egenskaper
  • Evne til å etablere tillitsfulle relasjoner til ungdom med ulik kulturell bakgrunn. 
  • Evne til å arbeide systematisk og målrettet.
  • Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner.
  • Evne til å arbeide selvstendig og samtidig bidra i et tverrfaglig fellesskap.
  • God rolleforståelse og evne til å balansere støtte, omsorg og myndighetsutøving.Personlige egenskaper vektlegges.
Vi tilbyr
  • Lønn i masterkode i tråd med lokalt stillingsregulativ Bergen kommune
  •  Medlemskap i BKP
  • Et flerkulturelt og trivelig arbeidsmiljø
  • Vi tilbyr spennende arbeidsoppgaver i et godt og faglig utfordrende arbeidsmiljø

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjort selv om søker ber om å bli unntatt fra offentlig søkerliste, jf. offentleglova § 25, annet ledd. Søker vil i så fall bli varslet om dette.

title: Avdelingsleder, Barne- og familiehjelpen Arna og Åsane
description:
Barne- og familietjenesten i Arna og Åsane har ledig et 100% vikariat som avdelingsleder i Barne- og familiehjelpen i Arna og Åsane. Vikariatet er ledig fra snarest og med varighet til 30.06.2027 med mulighet for forlengelse.

Vi ønsker en avdelingsleder med et stort og tydelig engasjement for ledelse, utviklingsarbeid og oppfølging av medarbeidere. Barne- og familietjenesten er under utvikling og som avdelingsleder vil du få mulighet til å være en pådriver i dette spennende arbeidet. Avdelingsleder vil være leder for avdelingen med et fag-, personal- og økonomiansvar for egen avdeling. Avdelingsleder rapporterer til enhetsleder i Barne- og familietjenesten og inngår i enhetsleders ledergruppe. Stillingen er 100% administrativ.

Barne- og familiehjelpen arbeider både etter lov om helse- og omsorgstjenester og etter lov om barneverntjenester. Vi har ett lavterskel helsetilbud for barn, ungdom og deres familier innen psykisk helse, samt at vi tilbyr kurs og veiledning til familier etter vedtak fra barneverntjenesten. Avdelingen har et flerfaglig arbeidsmiljø bestående av psykologer, familieterapeuter, kognitiv terapeut, vernepleier og sykepleier med relevante videreutdanninger. Barne- og familiehjelpen holder for tiden til i Myrdalsvegen 22. 

Avdelingen tilbyr bl.a.:Samtaler med terapeut eller psykologFamilieveiledningUlike gruppetilbud

Barne- og familiehjelpen er organisert under Barne- og familietjenesten i Etat for barn og familie. Barne- og familietjenesten består av helsestasjons- og skolehelsetjenesten, helsestasjon for ungdom, Ergo- og fysioterapitjenesten for barn og unge , kontorfaglig avdeling, samt Barne- og familiehjelpen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Fag:

  • Bidra til å nå organisasjonens overordnede visjon, strategi, mål og planer
  • Sikre kunnskapsbaserte tjenester i tråd med gjeldende lover, forskrifter og retningslinjer
  • Gjennomføre kvalitetsarbeid, herunder internkontroll og risikostyring
  • Ansvar for tverrfaglig samarbeid med relevante samarbeidspartnere internt og eksternt
  • Deltagelse i utviklingsarbeid
  • Medansvarlig for implementering i tråd med utviklingsarbeid
  • Følge opp vedtatte strategier, handlingsplaner og oppdragsnotat
  • Veiledning og opplæring innen definerte arbeidsområder

Personal:

  • Personalarbeid og ressursfordeling
  • Gjennomføre HMS-arbeid med fokus på forebygging og oppfølging av sykefravær
  • Bidra i enhetens samarbeid med tillitsvalgte og verneombud
  • Bidra i gjennomføringen av organisasjonsendringsprosesser i egen avdeling og i enheten som helhet
  • Gjennomføring av rekrutteringsprosesser  

Økonomi:

  • Sørge for god økonomisk styring av avdelingen i samarbeid med enhetsleder og ledergruppen

Listen over arbeidsoppgaver er ikke uttømmende.    

  Kvalifikasjoner
  • Det kreves relevant bachelor innen helse- og sosialfag
  • Relevant tilleggsutdanning og utdanning på masternivå vil vektlegges.
  • Formell lederutdanning og dokumentert praktisk ledererfaring vektlegges. Ledererfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning innen ledelse  
  • Bred erfaring og kjennskap fra aktuelle fagområder
  • Grunnleggende IKT-kompetanse er en forutsetning
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk er nødvendig 
  • Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse
Personlige egenskaper

Personlig egnethet vektlegges. Vi ser etter deg som: 

  • Har evne til å motivere og utvikle ansatte
  • Er endringsvillig, bevisst og reflektert på egen lederrolle
  • Har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsegenskaper
  • Kan arbeide analytisk med organisasjonens strategiske mål
  • Har økonomisk innsikt og forståelse
  • Har stor arbeidskapasitet
  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsdyktig 
  • Har evne til å jobbe helhetlig og strukturert, både selvstendig og i tverrfaglig team
Vi tilbyr
  • Varierte og spennende oppgaver
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • Mulighet til å være med på å utvikle nye tiltak
  • God pensjonsordning, og ulykkes- og gruppelivsforsikring
  • Lønn etter utdanning og praksis
  • En inkluderende arbeidslivsbedrift

 

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjort selv om søker ber om å bli unntatt fra offentlig søkerliste, jf. Offentlighetsloven § 25, annet ledd. Søker vil i så fall bli varslet om dette.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bergen kommune søker motiverte medarbeidere som er kompetente, åpne, pålitelige og samfunnsengasjerte. Kvalitet i tjenestene skapes gjennom godt arbeidsmiljø og mangfold blant ansatte.
