title: Senior System Architect
description: JobbeskrivningCompany Story Sigma Connectivity is a global tech house with all the resources needed to bring a product to market under one roof. We believe in investing in knowledge and education, making a positive impact on society and shaping a brighter future for all.Through our core values, at Sigma Connectivity we create an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Our company culture promotes the freedom to explore new ideas and push the boundaries of what is possible.Working with us means you will be working in an international environment with a diverse and inclusive atmosphere. We operate globally from 12 sites and have expert teams in North America, Sweden, Germany, Denmark, United Kingdom and Poland. We are looking for a Senior System Architect!In this role, you’ll translate client visions into robust blueprints for connected products, bridging hardware and software to define the project skeleton. As a part of the Industrialization & System Design team, you’ll own the end-to-end strategy for manufacturability, testability, and product launch—driving DFX (Design for Excellence, including DFM and DFT) directly into early PCB designs and defining test architectures from initial prototype validation through to mass production. What we offer    High-Impact Engineering: Own the technical vision for complex, market-defining products from concept to high-volume manufacturing.    World-Class Team & Culture: Work alongside elite cross-functional engineers in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.    Cutting-Edge Projects: Direct access to diverse, challenging hardware and IoT projects for leading global brands.    Autonomy & Influence: High visibility and direct influence over architectural decisions, client strategies, and design-for-test practices.Work tasksThis role focuses on the early-stage design and technical leadership of industrialization projects, ensuring that hardware and software components are optimized for production and testing.    Architecture & Strategy: Lead system architecture definitions and create comprehensive production test strategies that balance quality, yield, schedule, and cost.    Requirements Breakdown: Convert product, hardware, and quality constraints into clear specifications, including System Requirement Specifications, Production Test Requirements, and Test Implementation Specs.    DFX & Risk Management: Review hardware schematics and PCB concepts early to identify manufacturability, testability, and reliability risks, driving proactive mitigations with R&D teams.    Test Architecture Definition: Define test coverage, interfaces, embedded test functionality, fixtures, measurement methods, and factory data traceability.    Cross-Functional & Client Leadership: Drive technical discussions and balance trade-offs with customers, EMS partners, suppliers, R&D, quality, and sourcing teams.    Mentorship: Guide engineering teams on best practices in systems engineering, hardware testability, and production deployment.We are looking for someone with    A degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Engineering Physics, or equivalent practical background.    Proven experience working as a System Architect guiding complex electronic or embedded products from concept to production.    Proven background in production and manufacturing engineering, with strong practical experience bridging development and mass manufacturing environments.    Solid hardware depth to evaluate schematics, drive DFT/DFM improvements, and establish production test architectures alongside EMS partners.    Fluent English communication skills to present trade-offs, draft specifications, and align stakeholdersIt is meritorious if you have    Experience with connected/IoT devices, wireless protocols, or embedded systems.    Exposure to end-of-line testing, RF validation, JTAG, or factory yield optimization.    Track record supporting customer proposals, SOWs, or technical pre-studies.To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:    Supportive    Goal oriented    Social    Intellectually curious    Respectful ReferencesReference checks are conducted as part of the recruitment process and may include both provided and independently identified professional references.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description: Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura!Our AI Lab builds the shared platform that teams across Coretura use to develop and run AI products safely and reliably. We're looking for a senior software engineer to help design, build and run it.What you’ll doYou will work with the AI Lab to set the platform's technical direction, and take on a large share of the hands-on work yourself. Together, you'll build the platform that gives teams access to AI models across providers, manages and retrieves the data their AI products rely on, and provides the harnesses agents are built and run in. You'll also build agents yourself, and the observability that shows whether an AI product is giving the right answers, not just whether it's running.Beyond that, your work will include:    Security and safety by level: controls and evaluations that scale with how autonomous an AI system is and how safety-critical its use is, from everyday AI tools to autonomous agents, with prompt injection defences built in. The higher the level, the more a system has to prove before release and the more closely it's monitored once live. You'll build this together with our Security Hub.    Cost and resilience: usage metering built into the platform so teams can see what their AI products consume, and recovery tested for each AI product as a whole (model, knowledge base, prompts and tool integrations), not just the servers it runs on.    AI assets as code: prompts, agent definitions, model versions and evaluation datasets, versioned and released through automated pipelines. They change often and any change can shift how a product behaves, so every change is automatically tested, evaluated and traceable before it ships.Build to discover, then share what you learn. When we need to know whether an approach works, you build a working version, then use it to help colleagues across Coretura understand what works, what doesn't and why. As a senior engineer, you'll combine those findings with your own experience to help set where the platform goes next. You'll use AI coding agents in your own daily work and help other engineers adopt them safely. You'll also review designs and code, mentor the engineers around you, and hand over ownership of components as they're ready for it.You'll report to the AI Lab Lead and work closely with our Digital Architect and the teams behind our developer and data platforms.What you bringA solid background in software engineering, but we care far more about what you've done than how long you've been doing it. You've owned a production system end to end, including its roadmap, incidents and costs, and you've handed parts of it over to other engineers along the way.You're comfortable with:    Using AI coding agents as a normal part of how you write code, with work you can show for it    Building AI applications that people can rely on: agents, retrieval (RAG), model APIs and gateways, along with the evaluations that show they behave as intended    Defining cloud infrastructure in code and shipping through CI/CD as part of how you build software, with the observability to see how it behaves once it's running    Practical security, from least privilege and secrets management to prompt injection defences    Writing well-tested, maintainable code in whatever language the problem calls for, and picking up a new one when you need toYou look for more efficient ways to build and run things, bring structure to an unclear situation without locking it down too early, and can explain a trade-off so that engineers, security and leadership all understand it. Fluent English is a must.Why Coretura?We're a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, building a shared software platform for the next generation of commercial vehicles. We're a young company with very little legacy to work around, backed by two of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers.The AI platform serves teams across the company, so your work will directly affect how they build and ship software.If this sounds like the work you want to do, we look forward to your application.Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours!Last application date: 4th of December 2026.Questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to Frida Greve, frida.greve@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position.Please note we do not accept any applications via email.About our recruitment process  We are committed to a safe and secure working environment. As a mandatory part of our recruitment process, we carry out drug and alcohol testing and background checks via 2Secure on the final candidate. The background check covers personal details, financial information, company engagements, legal matters, CV verification, media and internet presence, as well as a risk analysis and recommendation.A negative drug and alcohol test and an approved background check are required before a formal offer can be made. All checks are carried out in accordance with GDPR, and candidates are always informed in advance.Read more →

title: MEP Manager
description: Key Requirements:    A third level qualification in a related field    5 years post qualification experience in a similar roleAs a member of the project management team, you have the opportunity to influence safety culture onsite by demonstrating personal commitment, setting clear expectations, and effectively communicating safety policies. By consistently modelling safe behaviour, prioritizing safety above productivity, and ensuring that all workers receive proper training and resources, you can foster an environment where safety is ingrained in every aspect of the construction process. Encouraging open communication, recognizing and rewarding safe behaviour, and conducting regular inspections further reinforce the importance of safety. By taking these steps, you can help create a culture where safety is a shared value and a top priority for all stakeholders involved in the project.Key Responsibilities:The Primary objective of the role is to provide MEPF support to Clients CM team, the GC team and the MEPF subcontractors on the client’s data centre builds. This involves interfacing with the GC/Client & MEPF Contractors / Clients CM / Clients DE / Clients Security / Client & MEP Consultants / Clients Cx / Local authorities and others as needed.Reporting to the MEP Operations Director your key responsibilities for the role will include but will not be limited to the following:    Foster a team approach to delivering your projects with your team.    Encourage your team to grow in their own roles and provide professional development where appropriate.    Review of IFC design for design issues / improvements and to determine where local alternatives with better lead times could be applied    Review incoming design change directives for impact to MEP works and establish if they can be implemented depending on site progress, and if they can be implemented determine a reasonable schedule impact    Work with the MEPF contractors and offer technical support on MEPF systems, clarify clients’ expectations and typical installation practices for client which may not necessarily be clarified on the IFC design    Review alternative technical proposals from the MEPF contractors to determine if proposal would be acceptable to client prior to formal submission where the contractor is required / chooses to deviate from the specification / design    Track and monitor MEPF shop drawings, RFI’s and technical submittals and push same works affecting the efficient MEPF progress.    Coordinate the sequence of MEPF works on behalf of the GC    Track, monitor and report on MEPF progress daily whilst monitoring manpower and equipment deployed across the sites    Review of progress against resources and forecast required resources to be deployed in order to meet / recover schedule    Offering MEPF contractors’ advice on long lead equipment handling, installation, and commissioning    Ensuring MEPF contractor provided equipment for installations and testing is secured well in advance    Review the quality of the MEPF installation whilst it is work in progress to minimize reworks    Advise MEPF contractors of client’s best practices and standards. Communicate clients’ expectations to the MEPF teams    Work with the MEPF contractors to close out comments and nonconformance reports    Review the MEPF contractors ITP’s, Inspection notices, pre-commissioning and commissioning plans and procedures with the aid of the commissioning manager    Provide guidance to the MEPF contractors on installation and coordination at site    Review and determine acceptable deviations from the design / shop drawings    Coordinate with the LLE vendors for equipment delivery, installation, testing and commissioning.    Review reported VS actual progress at site to verify contractor is on or behind schedule    Provide MEPF contractors with guidance on commissioning and oversee MEPF L1-L3 commissioning    Interface and support clients Cx team for L4-L5 commissioning    Management of MEPF contractors through to handover (TOC).    Review MEPF variations or change to scope and liaise with the commercial team for approval.    Identify potential risks and challenges related to MEP systems and develop mitigation strategies.    Implement and enforce quality control standards for MEP installations.    Develop and manage the project schedule for MEP installations, coordinating with other construction activities.    Facilitate effective communication between different project teams, subcontractors, and clients.    Facilitate the handover of MEP systems to the building owner or operator.    Lead by example and demonstrate a commitment to safety, quality, and professionalism.    Clearly define roles and responsibilities for each MEP team member on the project.    Prioritize safety and enforce strict adherence to safety protocols.    Regularly walk the construction site to observe work progress and ensure tasks are being performed according to specifications.    Document changes to the project plan, as well as any issues that may impact the schedule or budget.Strong time management and communication skills are essential to this role as well as computer literacy and the ability to prepare reports and administer necessary paperwork.

title: Post-doc position at the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness at SSE
description: About the Center for wellbeing, welfare and happiness and research areaWellbeing research examines how people experience and evaluate their lives, what enables them to thrive, and how individuals, organizations and societies can contribute to better lives. The field brings together perspectives from psychology, economics and behavioural science to understand different dimensions of wellbeing, including happiness, meaning in life and psychological richness. At the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness (CWWH), we connect these questions to the development of knowledge that can inform policy and practice.A central methodological challenge is how to capture the richness of people’s experiences through reliable and valid measures. Advances in natural language processing and large language models offer opportunities to complement traditional rating scales with systematic analyses of people’s own descriptions of their lives, emotions and experiences. This research combines wellbeing science, psychometrics and computational methods to investigate what language-based assessments can reveal about wellbeing, how they relate to established measures, and how they can capture differences between people and changes over time. The position will contribute to developing and validating these approaches, with relevance to the center’s research in Sweden and across countries.The roleThe postdoc will develop an independent research line on the measurement of wellbeing beyond traditional rating scales, with a focus on natural language (open-ended responses, text and speech) analyzed with computational methods, including large language models.The postdoc will contribute to the center's work on wellbeing in Sweden and across nations, co-author with center researchers, and connect CWWH to international collaborators and funding opportunities. The role also includes active participation in the center's outreach, such as media, public lectures and events. Your profileThe applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment and to be eligible, applicants must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the date of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm. Qualifications    PhD in business administration, psychology or a related field. Candidates with a set dissertation date may also apply.    A strong publication record in wellbeing science, including first-authored articles in leading international peer-reviewed journals    Documented expertise in language-based assessment of psychological constructs    Methodological and quantitative competence and programming in R and/or Python    Demonstrated research independence and an established international research network    Documented experience communicating research to non-academic audiences, e.g., media, public lectures or popular scienceMeritorious    Experience with assessment methods beyond self-report, e.g., implicit measures or automated coding of text    Development of open research software or openly shared models    Applied collaborations with organizations or industry, e.g., in work-related wellbeing or psychometrics How to apply: Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest December 15, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application:     A curriculum vitae     A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings).     Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5)     Evidence of stakeholder engagement, for example copies or links to blogs, opinion pieces, podcasts, LinkedIn posts     Names and contact information for two people willing to provide references. We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before December 15, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around April 2027. The employment is postdoctoral employment of two years.For further questions on the positions, please contact Assistant professor and Executive Director Fredrik Lange at fredrik.lange@hhs.seAbout the Stockholm School of EconomicsThe Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: Flödesledare - Power Pack, Surface Division
description: Company description:Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countriesJob description:Vill du leda människor, utveckla arbetssätt och skapa förutsättningar för en välfungerande produktion? Vi söker dig som motiveras av att skapa engagemang, utveckla människor och få team att lyckas tillsammans.  Allt börjar med människor. Människor som du. Bli en del av vårt team Vill du vara med och bygga upp något helt nytt från grunden? Vi tar nu hem monteringen av Power Pack och etablerar i samband med detta en helt ny avdelning med taktade produktionslinor. Därför söker vi en flödesledare som vill ta en nyckelroll i uppbyggnaden av den nya verksamheten. I rollen får du möjlighet att forma teamet, driva bemanningen och utveckla arbetssätt och produktionsflöden för att skapa en stabil och effektiv verksamhet från start. Du blir samtidigt en del av vår operativa ledningsgrupp tillsammans med tio andra flödesledare. Här får du ett nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor och en viktig roll i att tillsammans skapa en säker, stabil och välfungerande produktion.  Ditt uppdrag Som flödesledare leder du den operativa verksamheten och har personalansvar för cirka 20-25 medarbetare på skiftet. Du arbetar tvärfunktionellt och har som uppdrag att leverera moduler i rätt tid och med rätt bemanning. Tillsammans med teamet säkerställer du att vi levererar produkter med hög kvalitet, i rätt tid och på ett säkert sätt. Rollen kombinerar operativt ledarskap med administrativa uppgifter och du tillbringar en stor del av din arbetstid ute i verksamheten. Du kommer bland annat att:     Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetarna.      Ansvara för medarbetarsamtal, kompetensutveckling och andra personalrelaterade processer.      Säkerställa att rätt kompetens och resurser finns på plats utifrån verksamhetens behov.      Hålla dagliga avstämningar och följa upp teamets mål och resultat.        Bidra till arbetsmiljö- och förbättringsarbetet, exempelvis genom att hålla skyddsronder samt uppföljningar kopplade till 5S.      Säkerställa en smidig överlämning mellan dag- och eftermiddagsskiftet.  Din profil  Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta nära verksamheten och motiveras av att skapa förutsättningar för andra att lyckas. Du kommunicerar tydligt, bygger förtroende genom närvaro och lyhördhet och skapar engagemang kring gemensamma mål. Du samarbetar väl med andra, bygger goda relationer och bidrar till en miljö där människor känner sig inkluderade, delaktiga och uppmuntras att utvecklas. Du känner dig trygg i att ta ansvar, göra prioriteringar och prova nya arbetssätt som bidrar till teamets och verksamhetens utveckling. Vi välkomnar olika erfarenheter och bakgrunder och värdesätter din vilja att leda, utveckla människor och bidra till verksamhetens framgång. Vi söker dig som      Har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom produktion.      Har ett intresse för att leda och utveckla människor.      Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.      Har god datorvana.      Erfarenhet från en ledande, samordnande eller coachande roll.      Erfarenhet av projektledning.      Erfarenhet av förbättrings- och förändringsarbete.  Placering och övrig information Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning placerad inom Surface Division, vid produktionsanläggningen i Norra bro, Örebro.  Arbetstiden är förlagd dagtid, kl. 07:30 – 16:15. Ledarskapsförväntningar På Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare ska vara inspiratörer, acceleratorer och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som leder genom att vara förebilder och som har modet att utmana status quo. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare tar en aktiv roll i att främja säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald. Utöver detta värnar våra ledare om våra anställdas välbefinnande och kontinuerliga utveckling. Vi söker dig som vågar tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar.  Ansökan och kontaktinformation  Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 27/11- 2026. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter. För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta: Rekryterande chef Andreas Persson, andreas.f.persson@epiroc.com Rekryteringsspecialist, Susanne Kjellman, susanne.kjellman@external.epiroc.com

title: Spaceport Engineer  EGSE
description: Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.   With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.  SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.   Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace?  Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?    If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as EGSE (Electrical ground support equipment) Spaceport Engineer in our team. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.   Help build the systems that make rocket launches possible! As a Spaceport Engineer – EGSE, you will design, build and maintain the electrical ground support equipment used in testing and launch operations. Combining hands-on work with system ownership, you will collaborate with operations teams, suppliers and customers to bring reliable data acquisition and control systems into use. JOB REQUIREMENTS     A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.     A sound understanding of electrical engineering principles, particularly low-voltage instrumentation and control circuits.     Experience programming or configuring PLC and HMI systems, and using electrical drawings to build or troubleshoot panels and wiring harnesses.     A practical approach to solving technical problems, with the ability to take initiative and work closely with others to keep projects moving. Desired We welcome different technical backgrounds. Experience in some of the following areas would be valuable, and you do not need to bring them all:     Data acquisition and control systems in aerospace, industrial facilities or similar environments.     Technical documentation such as P&IDs, wiring schematics, control descriptions and instrument lists.     Industrial networks, communication protocols and hardware interfaces, or National Instruments tools used with LabVIEW.     Safety requirements and hazard analysis for ground support equipment.     Supporting technicians or mentoring junior engineers. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES    Design and develop instrumentation, data acquisition, PLC and HMI systems, including the electrical drawings and documentation needed to build and maintain them.     Build, test, troubleshoot and commission equipment, including instrument calibration and configuration.     Coordinate installation from site surveys and supplier quotations through to commissioning, training and technical support.     Work with operations teams to deliver safe, reliable systems that meet project, regulatory and operational requirements.     Carry out system checkouts and support testing and launch campaigns, including launch-day operations.     Define requirements and coordinate the installation of supporting power and communications infrastructure.  JOB BENEFITSWe offer you       A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.      An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.      An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.   Additional benefits  In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.       Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.      Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.       Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.      Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.      Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.  LOCATIONThis is a full-time, permanent position based at our Space Center Esrange outside of Kiruna.  NEXT STEPIf this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.  Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.  When applying, please include your CV. title: Supply Chain Sales Support Manager
description: Do you enjoy creating clarity at the intersection of customers, Sales and Supply Chain? We’re looking for a Supply Chain Sales Support Manager to lead our global function and develop a proactive, structured and data-driven service that colleagues and customers can rely on. At Seco, collaboration, responsibility, curiosity and continuous improvement guide how we work and grow. Here, you get to:     Lead a global function at the heart of customer order flow.     Shape how Sales and Supply Chain work together through clear governance, service levels, KPIs and digital tools.     Join a collaborative environment where curiosity and continuous learning are valued.   About the job  You lead and develop the global Supply Chain Sales Support function, creating a standardized, customer-focused and efficient interface between Sales and our end-to-end supply chain. With a clear focus on governance and proactive support, you ensure that customer needs, order exceptions and supply constraints are translated into priorities and coordinated action. The function is in the middle of a shift: building on a strong foundation in case handling towards an end-to-end control and improvement capability. You lead that change, and you lead it through people. Developing your team’s skills, ownership and confidence is as much a part of the job as the processes and tools. Job responsibilities     Lead, coach and develop the Supply Chain Sales Support team: set clear roles and expectations, build capability in customer communication, supply chain understanding, problem-solving and case management, and grow people into broader ownership.     Lead the development towards proactive exception management, building on the team’s case-handling expertise, and make new ways of working stick in daily operations.     Establish and maintain global governance across the order-to-delivery flow, including ownership boundaries, decision rights and escalation paths.     Act as the primary supply chain interface for Sales and Customer Service regarding prioritized orders, supply exceptions and special customer requirements.     Develop the service model, including case categories, service levels, prioritization principles, escalation protocols and KPIs.     Use case data and performance insights to identify root causes and drive structural improvements with the responsible process owners.     Drive digitalization of case management, workflows, reporting and knowledge management, reducing repetitive demand through automation and self-service. Location and flexibility  The position is flexible is preferably based in Fagersta, Sweden, but another Seco location can be considered for the right candidate. We offer a hybrid working model that combines time at the office with remote work. Your profile   You have solid experience in supply chain, logistics, planning, order management or customer service operations. Having worked at the intersection of a commercial organization and operational supply chain functions, you’re comfortable creating structure across complex, cross-functional environments and using data to support decisions. You communicate fluently in English; Swedish is considered an advantage. Your background includes:      Experience establishing processes, ownership models, escalation paths or service frameworks across multiple functions.     Knowledge of customer-order exceptions, escalations and prioritization, preferably within a case-based way of working.     The ability to identify recurring operational issues, uncover root causes and turn insights into structural improvements.     Experience using CRM or case-management systems, ERP data, KPIs and reporting.     People leadership experience and a university degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or equivalent experience. Customer focus and structure are central to your way of working. You simplify complex supply chain situations, create a shared understanding among commercial and operational colleagues and distinguish individual exceptions from structural problems. Calm and solution-focused, you challenge unnecessary manual work and fragmented processes while moving issues confidently towards resolution. The teamYou lead the global Supply Chain Sales Support team and work closely with Sales, Customer Service, Planning, Logistics, Production Units, Distribution Centres, IT and other operational functions. Together, you create globally consistent ways of working while accommodating relevant local requirements. Our Seco culture   At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit our LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us and our products further.    Contact information   For further information about this position, please contact Christian Shafi, Global Logistics & Supply Chain Sales Support Manager +46 (0)70- 741 92 28 We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.   Union contacts – Sweden        David Romlin, Unionen, +46 (0)70-608 46 90      Jörgen Andersson, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)70-548 10 70     Benny Christiansen, Ledarna, +46 (0)70-523 50 60  Recruitment Specialist: Heidi Pynnönen     How to apply Send us your application no later than November 27th, 2026. title: Production Support Technician – Automation
description: Aimpoint AB is the company that invented and developed the red dot sight, for which we are today the world-leading provider. Aimpoint sights are used in the civilian hunting and shooting markets, as well as by police and military forces. The company has over 570 employees and a turnover of approximately 2,3 billion SEK. Sales in the United States are managed through our American subsidiary, Aimpoint Inc.Our headquarters are located in Malmö, with production facilities in Malmö and Gällivare.Aimpoint is part of the Sandberg Development group. For more information about the company, please visit www.aimpoint.com/seProduction Support Technician – Automation Do you enjoy troubleshooting complex automation systems and solving technical challenges in a fast-paced production environment? At Aimpoint, you'll work with highly automated manufacturing equipment, advanced robotics, machine vision systems and modern production technology in an environment where continuous improvements and technical development are encouraged.We are looking for a Production Support Technician - Automation to join our Production Support team. In this role, you will be responsible for keeping our automated production lines running efficiently through troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, corrective actions, and continuous improvement. Working with robots, vision systems, PLC-controlled equipment, and advanced manufacturing technologies, you will play a vital role in supporting Aimpoint's continued growth and operational excellence.As our production capacity expands, you will also participate in the installation, commissioning, and optimization of new automated production lines and equipment.This position is permanently assigned to the night shift and includes an additional night shift allowance.In this role, you will:    Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in automated production equipment.    Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to maximize equipment uptime and reliability.    Analyze recurring issues, identify root causes, and implement long-term improvements.    Support production with expertise in automation, robotics, electrical systems, and machine troubleshooting.    Participate in the installation, commissioning, and optimization of new production lines and equipment.    Document maintenance activities and improvement actions in the maintenance management system (Idus).    Repair, adjust, and optimize tools and production equipment.    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across production and maintenance.    Support training and knowledge sharing related to new equipment, processes, and working methods.Required Qualifications    Technical education within Automation, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Technology, Maintenance, or equivalent experience.    Experience working with automated production equipment in a manufacturing environment.    Strong hands-on experience in troubleshooting electrical, mechanical and automated production equipment.    Familiarity with maintenance systems and technical documentation.    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.It is considered a strong advantage if you also have experience with:    ABB robots and robotic production equipment.    Cognex vision systems and machine vision technology.    Siemens PLCs and TIA Portal.    Pneumatic systems and industrial automation components.    Reading and troubleshooting electrical schematics.    LEAN manufacturing, TPM, and continuous improvement initiatives.    Root cause analysis and systematic problem-solving methodologies.To succeed in this role, you are analytical, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges independently. You enjoy working hands-on in a production environment and thrive when solving problems that have a direct impact on production performance.You see problems as challenges and work proactively to prevent production disruptions.You will join a skilled Production Support team working closely with Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering and Production Operations.The salary range for this position is SEK 38 000–45 000 depending on experience and qualifications.Why Aimpoint?We are driven by our core values: Performance, Innovation, and Commitment! - and we believe you are too!Just like us, you enjoy having fun at work and find interaction with others both challenging and rewarding. Collaboration with colleagues and customers is a natural part of the job.You can apply quickly and easily through our career page.Questions about the role?Feel free to contact P&C Sr Recruiting Specialist, Sofie Selind, at: sofie.selind@aimpoint.comApplications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.Learn more about us and how we handle your personal data on our website.Important InformationAt Aimpoint security is a key factor and due to this, we perform a background check on all positions within the company before employment.

title: Development Team Lead- Team Notification & Communication
description: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.The RoleThe RoleAs the Team Lead for Noco (Notification & Communication), you own two of the most trusted touchpoints in the traveler’s journey: the messages that keep customers informed, and the account experience that lets them manage their own journey. Every booking confirmation, schedule-change alert, receipt, and proactive notification a customer receives runs through your team’s systems — and so does the account functionality we’re actively building out to give travelers more control and visibility over their own data.You won’t just lead a team; you will be the bridge between Product, Platform, and the many domain teams who depend on reliable, well-governed communication and account infrastructure. Collaborate with your manager to make sure the team follows their agreed upon ways of working. You will lead a group of experienced engineers in maintaining a high-trust, high-reliability platform while helping shape where it goes next.Your ResponsibilitiesCoordinate Efforts: Keep the team aligned across two active fronts — communication infrastructure and the evolving Customer Account as well as future initiatives — ensuring both move forward smoothly without one starving the other of attention.Facilitate Communication: Serve as the bridge between your engineers and the stakeholders who depend on your systems, from Product Owners to stakeholders to the many domain teams whose customer-facing flows rely on your infrastructure.Technical Guidance: Drive the technical quality bar across both domains. Coordinate direction on complex technical issues with the help of the team.Team Empowerment: Empower your engineers to do their best work without micromanaging. Foster a culture of ownership for the health and performance of everything the team builds.Stakeholder Management: Keep everyone informed from your engineers to management, and communicate expectations as priorities shift.Ownership: Take end-to-end accountability for the team’s output — staying hands-on enough to guide technical decisions credibly, participating in recruitment, and providing appraisal input to your manager.Requirements    6+ years of experience in Java development, with exposure to system design and architecture.    Proven leadership or mentorship experience in a technical role.    A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.    Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build bridges between technical and business teams.BenefitsAt the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. Our shared ambition, passion, and strong work ethic are what drive us toward the same goals. This foundation allows us to value our individual differences, which we believe are precisely what make us a strong team. With us you can enjoy:    Our office is located in Merkurhuset in Gothenburg, a few steps away from public transport and lunch restaurants.    We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location    We love gaming and after work activities.    We know the value of personal development and continuous training.    Hackathons and Dev Weeks - We believe in promoting creativity and trying new things.    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

title: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description: Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en, RAI, at the Deaprtment of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineeering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team conducts basic and fundamental research into all aspects of robotics, with a specific focus on aerial, space and bio-inspired robotics. Subject description Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterised by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks. Project description RAI’s fundamental vision is to bridge the gap between theory and reality, and the team has a strong background in field robotics. Specific application areas we focus on include long-term autonomous missions in large and uncertain environments, semantic mission planning using foundation models, agentic task decomposition and event-driven replanning, and autonomous, semantically aware inspection of complex infrastructure. The RAI team has strong European and national participation in several research, development and innovation projects. Duties As a PhD student, you will conduct research with substantial theoretical and experimental components, to be published in peer-reviewed, internationally recognized journals and at major conferences. The position includes supervising degree projects and providing support with applications for funding from research funding agencies or councils, EU framework programmes or industry. The position may also include teaching assistance, seminars and presentations. You will work in the field of robot autonomy, and all activities will be linked to national, European and global research and development projects. The PhD position will involve intensive research activities in field experimentation and theoretical development. Research areas: Long-term autonomy in uncertain environments a. Agentic planning and reasoning - Semantic mission planning using foundation models - Task decomposition based on foundation models - Event-driven task replanning b. Autonomous inspection planning - Uncertainty aware planning - Multi-agent systems for inspection planning Qualifications To qualify for the position, you must hold a master’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science or another relevant subject. Good knowledge of C++, Python and ROS 2 is required. Good scientific skills, with demonstrated proficiency in experimental research, and very good communication skills are an advantage. You will represent the group in various contexts, both in Sweden and abroad, so very good knowledge of English is required. For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en. Further information Employment as a PhD student is limited to four years. Teaching and other departmental duties may be added, up to 20% of full-time working hours. The place of work is Luleå, and the starting date is by agreement. For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role. For further information, please contact: George Nikolakopoulos, Chaired Professor, +46 920-49 1298 mailto:geonik@ltu.se https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Tradeunioncontactsrepresentatives In case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions o this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence. description: \*\*Berne (et travail à domicile) \\\| 80\\-80% \\\|\*\* \*\*Ce à quoi vous pouvez contribuer\*\* \* Assurer la conception, la planification et la mise en œuvre des projets de recherche et d'évaluation mandatés dans le domaine de la sécurité sociale \* Assurer un suivi de haute qualité et efficace des projets sur les plans financier et administratif et garantir le respect des délais \* Mettre en valeur les résultats de projets de recherche et d'évaluation par la rédaction d'articles les concernant \* Réaliser des revues de littérature, mener des analyses de données et publier des rapports de référence. \* Présenter des exposés lors d'événements et de réunions, planifier et animer des ateliers \*\*Ce qui vous rend unique\*\* \* Diplôme universitaire (idéalement un doctorat) en sciences économiques ou sociales \* Expérience approfondie dans la réalisation d'études empiriques, notamment dans l'analyse et l'évaluation appliquées des politiques publiques, tant sur le plan quantitatif et qualitatif \* Compétences avérées en gestion de projet de recherche \* Capacités d'analyse, pensée en réseau et intérêt pour les questions politiques \* Bonne connaissance du système de sécurité sociale ainsi qu'une solide expérience dans le traitement des données de santé \* Grande aisance à s'exprimer en public et solides compétences de présentation \* Connaissances actives de deux langues officielles et très bonnes connaissances de l'anglais \*\*En quelques mots\*\* Les questions de politique sociale vous intéressent ? En qualité de sociologue au sein de notre secteur dans le domaine Mathématiques, analyses et statistiques, vous êtes responsable de projets de recherche et d'évaluation complexes et élaborez des bases fondées sur des données probantes pour les processus de décision politique. En collaboration avec le reste de l'équipe, vous participez en outre à la définition de l'orientation stratégique du secteur. \*\*Ce que nous offrons\*\* \* \*\*Travailler pour la Suisse\*\* Nous nous engageons pour le succès du modèle suisse et pour le bien\\-être de la population. \* \*\*La diversité au quotidien\*\* Nous veillons à l'égalité des chances, qui nous permet de déployer nos compétences et d'exprimer des points de vue différents. \* \*\*Santé au travail\*\* Nous assistons et conseillons nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs pour toutes les questions liées à la santé physique ou psychique. \[Tous les avantages\](\< \>) \*\*Nous façonnons la sécurité sociale pour la Suisse de demain\*\* L'Office fédéral des assurances sociales (OFAS) veille à ce que le système de la sécurité sociale soit pleinement opérationnel et réponde aux nouveaux enjeux. Il est aussi le centre de compétences de la Confédération pour la politique sociale et pour tout ce qui touche à la famille, à l'enfance, à la jeunesse et aux relations intergénérationnelles. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Media Relations &amp; Communications Manager:in (80–100 %)--- Media Relations \& Communications Manager:in (80–100 %)=========================================================**Du weisst, welche Geschichten zählen und gibst wichtigen Themen eine Stimme.**Als grösste unabhängige Kinderrechtsorganisation setzt sich Save the Children seit 1919 gezielt für die Rechte der Kinder ein. In der Schweiz und auf der ganzen Welt sorgen wir dafür, dass Kinder gesund aufwachsen, zur Schule gehen können und geschützt sind.  Wir suchen per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung dich als**Media Relations \& Communications Manager:in** **(80 \- 100%)**=================================================================### **Was deinen besonders spannend macht*** **Medienarbeit:** Du identifizierst relevante Themen aus unseren Schweizer und internationalen Programmen, bereitest sie journalistisch auf und bringst sie aktiv in die Schweizer Medien* **Medienkontakte und \-anfragen:** Du baust tragfähige Beziehungen zu Medienschaffenden in der Deutsch\- und Westschweiz auf, verfasst Medienmitteilungen und Stellungnahmen, koordinierst Interviews und begleitest Medienauftritte. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem internationalen Netzwerk zusammen* **Institutionelle Kommunikation:** Du verfasst und redigierst Beiträge für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und Kanäle, wirkst an Stellungnahmen, Anlässen und Präsentationen mit, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung, den Fachbereichen und unserem \& Digital Team* **Interne Kommunikation:** Du realisierst interne Informationsformate und Veranstaltungen und sorgst für einen zielgerichteten Informationsfluss innerhalb der Organisation* **Jahresbericht:** Du verantwortest die Erstellung unseres Jahresberichts – von der inhaltlichen Konzeption und Redaktion bis zur Koordination der Umsetzung### **Dein Erfahrungsschatz*** Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung in Kommunikation, Journalismus oder einem verwandten Bereich und bringst fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Medien\- und Kommunikationsarbeit mit* Du kennst die Schweizer Medienlandschaft und journalistische Arbeitsweisen, erkennst Nachrichtenwert und verstehst es, relevante Themen zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten und erfolgreich an Medienschaffende heranzutragen. Ein bestehendes Mediennetzwerk ist von Vorteil* Du bist versiert in der Konzeption, Redaktion und Umsetzung unterschiedlicher Kommunikationsformate – von Medienmitteilungen und Stellungnahmen über institutionelle Beiträge bis hin zur internen Kommunikation* Du formulierst schriftlich und mündlich präzise, überzeugend und stilsicher auf Deutsch und verfügst über sehr gute Englisch\- und ösischkenntnisse* Du gehst offen und souverän auf unterschiedliche Menschen zu, verstehst verschiedene Perspektiven und Interessen und pflegst eine konstruktive, respektvolle Zusammenarbeit* Du denkst mit und voraus, bringst eigene Ideen ein und setzt Vorhaben kreativ, strukturiert und zuverlässig um. Dabei handelst du lösungsorientiert, pragmatisch und mit gutem Urteilsvermögen### **Was dich bei uns erwartet*** Eine sinnvolle Tätigkeit mit gesellschaftlicher Relevanz* Ein engagiertes Team mit einer unkomplizierten, wertschätzenden Arbeitskultur* Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Homeoffice Möglichkeiten und zentrale Büros in Zürich* Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und moderne SozialleistungenWir fördern die Diversität in unserem Team und begrüssen deshalb Bewerbungen von Menschen verschiedener Nationalität(en), ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religionen und Weltanschauungen, sexueller Orientierung und Identität, verschiedenen Alters und Geschlechts sowie von Menschen mit Behinderungen.  Basis unserer Arbeit ist die UN\-Kinderrechtskonvention. Zum Schutz von Kindern und Jugendlichen sind alle Mitarbeitenden zur Unterzeichnung der Save the Children Selbstverpflichtungserklärung zum Schutz der Kinder und zur Vorlage eines aktuellen Privat\- und Sonderprivatauszuges verpflichtet.  **Deine Worte schaffen Aufmerksamkeit. Dein Engagement bewirkt Veränderung.** Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.  ![Save the Children - Organisation für die Rechte der Kinder]()* Save the Children \- Organisation für die Rechte der Kinder  Sihlquai 253  8005 Zürich*jidec648b1jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Responsable Gérance et Center Management
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Responsable Gérance et Center Management--- Responsable Gérance et Center Management=========================================La Société coopérative Migros Vaud compte près de 3’200 collaborateurs et exploite aujourd’hui un réseau d’une soixantaine de magasins dans le canton. Son département Immobilier assure la gestion, la valorisation et le développement d’un patrimoine diversifié comprenant notamment des centres commerciaux, des surfaces commerciales et des immeubles de rendement. À la suite du départ du titulaire du poste, Migros Vaud souhaite confier la responsabilité de son service Gérance immobilière et Center Management à une nouvelle personne. L’enjeu sera à la fois d’en assurer la continuité, de reprendre la responsabilité de l'équipe et de la faire évoluer et d’accompagner un département appelé à jouer un rôle central au regard des ambitions de développement de la coopérative. Afin de relever ces défis, nous recherchons un·e Responsable Gérance et Center Management-----------------------------------------### Piloter, valoriser et développer un parc immobilier au cœur de l'activité commerciale### Vos responsabilitésEn qualité de Responsable de service, vous pilotez la Gérance immobilière et le Center Management de Migros Vaud. À la tête d’une petite équipe, vous fixez les priorités, organisez l’activité et développez l’autonomie de vos collaborateurs. Une part importante de votre fonction concerne les surfaces commerciales : vous entretenez les relations avec les enseignes et partenaires, conduisez les négociations locatives, contribuez à la recherche de nouveaux locataires et accompagnez les évolutions du parc. Vous supervisez parallèlement le reste du portefeuille immobilier, notamment les immeubles de rendement, en vous appuyant sur les compétences de votre équipe. Vous suivez les principaux indicateurs financiers et opérationnels, la rentabilité des actifs et la qualité des prestations, tout en faisant évoluer les pratiques, l’organisation et la performance du service. ### Votre profilManager de proximité, vous savez fédérer, responsabiliser et faire progresser une équipe tout en restant proche du terrain et en vous impliquant directement dans les dossiers lorsque nécessaire. Pragmatique, orienté·e résultats et doté·e d’un excellent sens relationnel, vous conjuguez exigence, sens du service et capacité à décider. Votre sens commercial et votre connaissance du marché vous permettent d’identifier les bons interlocuteurs, de construire des relations durables et de défendre les intérêts de l’organisation. Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée dans l’immobilier commercial, le retail ou le center management et maîtrisez les enjeux liés à la commercialisation de surfaces et aux baux commerciaux. À l’aise dans la négociation, vous disposez idéalement d’un réseau établi auprès des acteurs du marché romand. Une expérience complémentaire de la gérance immobilière résidentielle constitue un atout.![Move UP SA]()* Move UP SA  Route de Cité\-Ouest 2  1196 Gland*jid0e6f434jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Coordinateur·ice de programme Duo 90-100%--- Coordinateur·ice de programme Duo 90\-100%===========================================*Caritas Vaud agit avec les personnes en situation de précarité sociale ou économique, pour améliorer concrètement leurs conditions de vie, favoriser leur autonomie et promouvoir leur inclusion dans le canton de Vaud.* La mesure Duo de Caritas Vaud propose aux bénéficiaires du revenu d’insertion (RI) un accompagnement individualisé fondé sur le mentorat bénévole. Elle vise à renforcer leur autonomie et leur confiance en eux en les soutenant dans leurs démarches liées à l’insertion sociale et professionnelle, notamment dans les domaines de l’emploi, du logement, de l’administration ou de l’apprentissage du français. Afin de renforcer notre dispositif, nous sommes à la recherche d’un·e :**Coordinateur**·**ice de programme Duo à 90\-100%****CDI à Lausanne**Rejoignez Caritas Vaud ! À ce poste, vous assurez la coordination de la mesure Duo sur le canton de Vaud. Rattaché·e à la Cheffe du secteur Insertion, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les autres coordinateur·trices de programmes ainsi qu’avec la spécialiste du bénévolat.Vos principales missions sont les suivantes :Assurer la gestion du programme Duo, notamment l’analyse et le traitement des demandes d’accompagnement ;Mettre en place et assurer le suivi des mesures Duo en collaboration avec les mandants (CSR, CSIR, etc.) ;Animer et promouvoir la mesure Duo auprès des partenaires et du public cible ;Assurer le suivi des bénéficiaires et des mandants, ainsi que la rédaction de bilans et de rapports ;Représenter la prestation auprès des partenaires communaux et cantonaux ;Recruter des bénévoles pour les mentorats ;Assurer le suivi et l’encadrement des bénévoles ;Animer les séances d’accueil et les formations destinées aux bénévoles ;Participer à l’amélioration continue et au développement de la prestation.Votre profil :Au bénéfice d’un bachelor dans le domaine social, de la formation d’adultes, de l’animation socioculturelle ou d’une formation jugée équivalente ;Expérience professionnelle d’au moins 3 ans dans l’accompagnement social ou la coordination de prestations ;Expérience dans le suivi et l’accompagnement de bénéficiaires ainsi que dans la collaboration avec un réseau de partenaires. Mais également dans le recrutement, l’encadrement et le développement des bénévoles ;Bonne connaissance du réseau social vaudois, des assurances sociales et du fonctionnement des institutions sociales ;Compétence reconnue dans la gestion administrative, notamment la rédaction de rapports, de bilans et de documents de suivi ;Intérêt marqué pour les thématiques de l’intégration sociale, de l’orientation et de l’insertion.**Vous êtes**Organisé·e, rigoureux·se et autonome, vous êtes capable de coordonner plusieurs suivis simultanément. Vous disposez d’excellentes compétences relationnelles et appréciez le travail en réseau avec des partenaires et profils variés. Vous faites preuve d’écoute, d’empathie et de discernement dans l’accompagnement des personnes. Dynamique et force de proposition, vous contribuez activement au développement des prestations ainsi qu’à leur promotion auprès des partenaires institutionnels et du grand public. Doté·e de bonnes capacités d’animation, vous appréciez également transmettre vos connaissances dans le cadre de formations ou de séances d’information. **Entrée en fonction : 1er février 2027****Délai de postulation : 02 décembre 2026** *Nous nous réjouissons de votre future candidature et vous remercions pour l’envoi de votre dossier complet via JobUp . Chaque jour, nos équipes partagent leur expertise et leurs cultures pour offrir aux enfants et à leurs familles une fenêtre sur le monde.Chaque enfant est différent : l'éducation durable n'est pas la même pour tous, mais la meilleure pour chacun. C'est pourquoi nous sommes ouverts à de grandes pédagogies spécifiques afin d'éviter les limites de chacune et de répondre à la diversité des besoins de chaque enfant et de chaque parent dans le cadre d'un projet éducatif commun fort. title: Consultant junior en recrutement IT - H/F
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Consultant junior en recrutement IT - H/F--- Consultant junior en recrutement IT \- H/F==========================================Membre du groupe Sigmalis, actif depuis 2007 dans le conseil et l’ingénierie en informatique, Sigmalis Talent Services accompagne les entreprises dans l’identification et l’attraction d'experts IT et de cadres, en proposant une offre complète en recrutement: placement fixe, délégation en régie, mission temporaire et executive search.Notre expertise en recrutement depuis plus de 20 ans en Suisse Romande, associée à une compréhension approfondie des métiers technologiques et des enjeux RH, nous permet de vous proposer des opportunités pertinentes dans des environnements professionnels réellement adaptés à vos attentes. Notre priorité est d’assurer votre réussite sur le long terme, que vous soyez en recherche d’un poste fixe chez un client ou comme consultant au sein de notre équipe.### Description du posteVous souhaitez exercer le métier de recruteur dans un environnement où la technologie, la qualité de la relation humaine et la connaissance du marché sont au cœur du métier ?Rejoignez **Sigmalis Talent Services** et participez au développement d’un groupe suisse à taille humaine, spécialisé dans les métiers de l’informatique.**Le groupe Sigmalis**Présent en Suisse romande depuis 2007, **Sigmalis** ESN basée à Genève, accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets informatiques grâce à ses expertises en développement applicatif, Business Intelligence et Data Management. Ses consultants interviennent aussi bien en consulting que dans le cadre de projets réalisés au forfait.**Sigmalis Talent Services**, société sœur spécialisée dans le recrutement IT, accompagne les entreprises dans la recherche et la sélection de profils informatiques, dans le cadre de recrutements fixes ou de missions temporaires.Cette complémentarité nous permet de conjuguer connaissance des métiers IT, expertise du recrutement et proximité avec le marché suisse romand.**Votre mission**Vous prenez en charge l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu'au suivi des candidats.Vous intervenez aussi bien sur les recrutements destinés à renforcer les équipes de consultants du groupe que sur les mandats confiés à Sigmalis Talent Services par ses clients.Votre rôle ne consiste pas uniquement à identifier des CV : vous cherchez à comprendre les parcours, les compétences techniques, les motivations et les aspirations professionnelles afin de créer des mises en relation pertinentes et durables.**Vos principales responsabilités*** Comprendre les besoins récurrents en recrutement, les environnements techniques et les profils recherchés,* Définir et déployer les stratégies de sourcing et d'approche directe les plus adaptées,* Rédiger et publier des offres d'emploi attractives et ciblées,* Identifier et approcher des candidats via les différents outils, réseaux professionnels et techniques de chasse de tête,* Analyser les candidatures et évaluer leur adéquation avec les exigences techniques, professionnelles et humaines du poste,* Préparer et conduire des entretiens approfondis et structurés,* Rédiger des comptes rendus d'entretien détaillés,* Accompagner les candidats tout au long du processus et assurer un suivi régulier et professionnel,* Garantir la qualité et la mise à jour des informations dans notre ATS et constituer des viviers de talents sur les profils régulièrement recherchés par notre groupe,* Développer une relation de proximité avec les équipes internes du groupe et comprendre leurs besoins actuels et futurs,* Contribuer à l'attractivité de nos opportunités et à notre marque employeur.### Profil recherché* Vous disposez **1 à 3 ans d'expérience dans le recrutement de profils IT au sein d'une agence de recrutement ou d'une société de services informatiques, idéalement en Suisse romande**.Vous disposez également des compétences et qualités suivantes :* Excellente maîtrise des méthodes de sourcing, de recherche directe et de chasse de tête,* Bonne connaissance des principaux métiers et technologies informatiques,* Capacité à conduire des entretiens structurés et à évaluer une candidature au\-delà des seuls éléments du CV,* De langue maternelle française ou niveau équivalent, avec d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et un bon niveau d'anglais vous permettant de conduire des entretiens avec des candidats anglophones,* Sens de l'organisation, rigueur et capacité à gérer plusieurs recrutements et priorités simultanément,* Excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens de la communication,* Autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats,* Goût du travail en équipe et capacité à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs et métiers,* Respect absolu de la confidentialité et de l'éthique inhérentes au métier du recrutement.Nous recherchons une personne qui souhaite **s'investir dans la durée**, développer son expertise et contribuer activement à la croissance de notre activité.**Rejoindre Sigmalis Talent Services, c'est…****Intégrer un groupe suisse à taille humaine**, dans lequel les échanges sont directs et les responsabilités réelles.**Exercer pleinement votre métier de recruteur**, de l'analyse du besoin à l'accompagnement du candidat, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité des recrutements.**Évoluer au contact de spécialistes de l'IT**, qui permettent de mieux comprendre les métiers, les environnements techniques et les enjeux rencontrés par nos clients.**Construire des relations de proximité avec les candidats**, en privilégiant la qualité des échanges et du suivi plutôt qu'une approche purement quantitative du recrutement.**Travailler sur des missions variées**, aussi bien pour les besoins internes du groupe que pour des entreprises et organisations de Suisse romande.Enfin, nous accordons une importance particulière à **l'éthique, la confidentialité, la qualité du travail réalisé et au respect des engagements pris envers nos candidats comme envers nos clients**.Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette approche du recrutement et souhaitez poursuivre votre parcours dans un environnement spécialisé IT ?Nous serons heureux de découvrir votre candidature et d'échanger avec vous sur votre parcours et vos aspirations professionnelles.![SIGMALIS Sàrl]()* SIGMALIS Sàrl  Route de Meyrin 123  1219 Châtelaine*jid4ebe5c6jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Green Power Business Development & Investments
description: About The RoleRole type: Permanent | Location: Lausanne, Switzerland | Model:| Level of travels: 40%Our CompanyAlpiq is one of Switzerland’s leading electricity producers and a key energy services provider across Europe. Headquartered in Lausanne and powered by a strong portfolio of hydropower, nuclear, and renewable energy sources, we’re all about impact, for the climate, for people, and for the security of supply.More than 1,300 colleagues from nearly 60 nationalities bring their energy to a shared purpose: Together for a better climate and an improved security of supply.We work in a values-driven culture shaped by trust, curiosity, and respect. Our 4 company values have been co-created with our employees and are embedded in everything we do as a company:“We are ALP1Q “- reflects our team spirit“We learn and grow together” - we have courage“We share the steering wheel” - we take ownership“We focus on the outcome” - your impact mattersAt Alpiq, your energy matters!The OpportunityJoin Alpiq's Green Power Business Development team to originate, evaluate and advance renewable energy and flexibility investments across Europe, including battery storage, pumped-storage hydropower and renewable generation. Reporting directly to the Head of Business Development, you will take ownership of selected projects from screening through development, investment approval and transaction execution.This is a hands-on role for someone who combines investment expertise with delivery. You will master each project's economics, commercial structure, risks and execution requirements, do the detailed work yourself and drive it forward with internal specialists and external partners.Your Main ResponsibilitiesScreen and prioritize opportunities; develop a clear view on value creation, strategic fit and whether to proceed, reshape or stop.Build, review and own financial models, valuations and investment cases, testing revenue assumptions, capital costs, financing, returns and downside scenarios.Analyze European power markets, regulation and competing projects; translate market intelligence into practical investment recommendations.Develop commercial and transaction structures, including acquisitions, partnerships, co-investments and tolling arrangements, working closely with M&A and trading.Prepare and drive commercial negotiations with developers, investors and advisers, supported by legal and relevant specialists.Lead due diligence and cross-functional coordination across finance, M&A, trading, engineering, legal and local development teams; resolve issues and close actions.Draft concise Executive Board and investment-committee papers, with clear economics, risks, open points and decisions requested; distinguish negotiation conditions from internal approval requirements.Own project plans, budgets, milestones and governance; maintain an accurate pipeline, escalate blockers early and follow through on approvals and execution.Your profile5-8 years of relevant experience in business development, investments, M&A, infrastructure or corporate development; a relevant degree, with an MBA preferred.Demonstrated hands-on experience across financial modeling, investment papers, commercial structuring, negotiations, due diligence, market analysis and project delivery.Strong understanding of energy or infrastructure investment economics; renewable generation, storage and European power-market experience is an advantage.Ability to independently own projects, challenge assumptions, exercise commercial judgment and deliver through cross-functional teams.Advanced Excel and strong PowerPoint and written communication skills; able to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations.Full professional fluency in English; French, German, Italian or Spanish is strongly preferred. Eligible to work in Switzerland and willing to travel across Europe.What Matters MostYou are a doer: accountable, pragmatic and comfortable moving between detailed analysis and external discussions. You identify what matters, propose workable solutions and deliver without constant direction. Curiosity, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration and a low-ego approach matter as much as technical expertise.We focus on outcomes, share the steering wheel and encourage curiosity. Different perspectives are welcome. Candidates are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet every requirement: skills can be developed, while motivation and the right mindset are essential.Your BenefitsCompetitive salary packageMarket-oriented salaryTraining and developmentDiverse opportunities for career growthFlexible work modelsVarious flexible work models

une réelle aisance relationnelle, le goût du conseil et la capacité à établir des relations de confiance durables* un esprit analytique et critique, associé à une capacité à formuler des travailler au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires* vous êtes mobile et appréciez de collaborer avec les équipes de nos différents sites* une bonne connaissance du marché immobilier régional.**Nous operational procedures.* Develop governance structures, operational standards, and sustainable processes.* Monitor operational KPIs and coordinate corrective actions where needed.* Maintain a consistent framework for operational execution across the fleet. **Guest Experience \& Continuous Improvement** * Analyze guest feedback, cruise reports, audits, and operational reviews.* Identify opportunities to enhance service delivery and operational effectiveness.* Lead the development and implementation of new hotel concepts, processes, and best practices.* Support innovation initiatives that elevate the overall guest experience. **Leadership \& Organizational Development** * Lead and develop Corporate Hotel Managers.* accountability, collaboration, and professional growth throughout the organization.* Strengthen leadership capabilities through talent development and succession planning.* Promote transparent communication and strong partnerships between shipboard and shore\-side teams. **Financial Performance** * Contribute to hotel operations budgets and resource planning.* Monitor performance against financial targets and operational objectives.* Identify risks, opportunities, and efficiency improvements.* Support sustainable and commercially sound decision\-making across the fleet. **Supplier \& Stakeholder Management** * Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and service partners.* Ensure suppliers meet quality, reliability, and performance expectations.* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align operational strategies with broader business objectives. **What You Bring** **Experience** * Minimum 5 years of senior leadership experience within river cruising, ocean cruising, hospitality, hotel operations, or comparable service industries.* Proven success managing multi\-site operational environments.* Experience leading diverse, international teams.* Strong understanding of operational excellence,
