title: Senior Product / System Quality & Verification Engineer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Product / System Quality &amp; Verification Engineer--- Senior Product / System Quality \& Verification Engineer========================================================We are looking for a Senior Product / System Quality \& Verification Engineer to help establish and drive product quality from our first rideable prototypes through development and toward production.This is a hands\-on, cross\-functional individual contributor role at the intersection of product quality, systems integration, verification and reliability.You will work across mechanical, electrical, embedded software, connectivity and system interfaces. You are not expected to be the deepest technical expert in every domain—that responsibility remains with the respective Engineering teams. Instead, you will provide the independent quality perspective that connects these domains and ensures that the complete product is adequately verified, integrated, and ready for release.You will work closely with Mechanical Engineering, System Engineering, Embedded Software / Electronics, Product Management, suppliers and eventually Manufacturing and Service teams.**Key responsibilities**Plan, coordinate, and review verification and validation activities for components, subsystems, and complete e\-bike systems.Define and govern Minimum Test Requirements (MTRs) together with Engineering and suppliers, including appropriate test methods, conditions, sample sizes, and acceptance criteria.Review Supplier validation plans and test evidence, and challenge whether the proposed verification provides sufficient evidence that product requirements are met.Drive and coordinate system integration and end\-to\-end testing to ensure hardware, software, connectivity, and mobile app functions work reliably together.Own and maintain the FRACAS process, leading investigations into complex mechanical, electrical, software, and system\-level issues through root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, verification, and continuous learning.Define and coordinate reliability, durability, environmental, and field\-testing programs to identify risks and improve product robustness before launch.Coordinate homologation and certification testing, and release readiness reviews, ensuring compliance requirements are met and product quality is maintained throughout development.**What success looks like**Success in this role means that, as we move from prototypes toward production, we can confidently answer key questions about product readiness: What are the critical requirements? How are they being verified? Are the tests sufficiently rigorous? What issues have been found, and have the fixes been proven effective?You will ensure that verification activities, test results, product configurations, and compliance evidence are well structured, traceable, and visible, enabling informed decisions on product readiness, certification status, and release milestones.Success also means establishing a robust FRACAS and problem\-solving culture where issues are identified early, investigated systematically, resolved through verified corrective actions, and used to drive continuous improvement across products and processes.Ultimately, you will help build confidence that the complete e\-bike and it’s system is reliable, compliant, and ready for launch, not just at the component level but as an integrated product.Engineering teams will see Quality as a trusted partner that helps identify risks early, challenge assumptions constructively, and support successful product releases.**What you bring**5\+ years of experience in product quality, verification \& validation, reliability engineering, systems engineering, or a related discipline.Experience with complex mechatronic products such as e\-bikes, automotive systems, motorcycles, robotics, or consumer electronics.Strong understanding of verification, validation, reliability engineering, and structured problem\-solving methodologies such as FRACAS, 8D, or equivalent.A systems\-thinking mindset with the ability to work across mechanical, electrical, software, and connectivity domains, and understand how they interact in a complete product.Experience coordinating suppliers, validation activities, and complex system integration across multiple engineering disciplines.Ability to review and challenge test plans, Minimum Test Requirements, validation strategies, and technical evidence without needing to be the deepest subject matter expert in every domain.Comfortable working hands\-on with prototypes, test equipment, diagnostic tools, test data, and failure investigations.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, suppliers, and external test partners.Fluent English; or Swiss an advantage given the Switzerland base.![Viiala SA]()* Viiala SA  Route de Crassier 7  1262 Eysins*jid0d25577jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

a relevant degree, with an MBA preferred.Demonstrated hands-on experience across financial modeling, investment papers, commercial structuring, negotiations, due diligence, market analysis and project delivery.Strong understanding of energy or infrastructure investment economics; description: Interested in a senior leadership role working in a stimulating and challenging environment? title: Cloud Operations Lead
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Cloud Operations Lead--- Cloud Operations Lead=====================Welcome to **Xelon** – where technology meets innovation and customer centricity. As we continue to grow our Platform team, we are looking for a**Cloud Operations Lead (80\-100%)**to join our team. In this role, you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incidents, recovery, and the service desk that customers reach first. When something has to keep running at Xelon, you make it run.At **Xelon**, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From **IaaS** to **SaaS**, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like **technology**, **finance, insurance, and public services**. Our solutions \- **Xelon Cloud**, **Xelon Secure\+** and **Xelon HQ** combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one ecosystem.We are on a mission to become the **\#1 Swiss Cloud Enabler**, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.Tasks-----**Your Mission**As Cloud Operations Lead you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incident response, monitoring, backup and recovery, and the infrastructure underneath. The service desk is part of your team, so you also own what customers experience every time they contact us. You lead a team of four to six people, and you are the person the business relies on when something has to keep running.Xelon is building a new platform over the coming years. VMware carries the production estate through that transition and stays in place for at least the next two years, alongside other hypervisors. You run that environment, you keep it stable and auditable, and you make sure the transition never happens at the expense of the customers on it.Platform strategy, target architecture and the technology roadmap sit with the Head of Platform \& Technology. You are a close partner in those decisions and you own their operational reality.**What You Own in the First 12 Months*** **Availability and customer satisfaction.** You hit the agreed availability targets and hold them, and customers experience both the platform and the service desk as dependable, with incidents resolved quickly and communicated clearly.* **ISO 27001 and audit readiness.** Operational evidence, documentation and patch compliance stay audit\-ready throughout the year instead of being assembled in the weeks before each audit.* **Team depth.** No critical part of the platform depends on one person, and every engineer in the team has a development path they can name.**Responsibilities*** **Operations and multi\-hypervisor environment:** Operate and optimise the production estate across a multi\-hypervisor environment, with VMware as the primary platform. Keep availability, performance and capacity ahead of demand as the customer base grows. Own hardware lifecycle, capacity planning and datacenter operations together with our partners.* **Networking, storage and datacenter:** Own the operational side of network and storage: segmentation, routing, firewalling, DNS, load balancing, and the storage layer underneath the platform. Raise the level of networking knowledge and practice across the team.* **Monitoring, incident response and recovery:** Run and improve monitoring, alerting and logging so that problems surface before customers report them. Own backup and disaster recovery, including proving that restores actually work.* **Service desk and customer support:** Lead the service desk: intake, triage, ticket quality and response times against agreed service levels. Own what customers experience when they contact us, from the first response through to clear communication during an incident. Act as escalation point for 1st and 2nd level support incidents. Turn recurring tickets into fixes together with the engineering side of the team, rather than absorbing them as routine.* **Team leadership:** Lead, coach and develop a team of four to six people across cloud operations and the service desk. Build development plans and remove single points of knowledge. Set on\-call, shift and service desk coverage the team can sustain.* **Automation and process:** Move recurring manual operations into Infrastructure as Code and scripting. Improve the operational toolchain and the handover points with DevOps, Support and Product. Apply service management practice where it reduces friction, not as an end in itself.* **Compliance and audit readiness:** Keep operations aligned with ISO 27001, ISAE and Swiss data sovereignty requirements. Work with Dev\- and SecOps on hardening, patch compliance and audit evidence. Maintain operational documentation that holds up in an audit.* **Budget, vendors and procurement:** Co\-own the operational CAPEX and OPEX budget with the Head of Platform \& Technology. Manage vendor relationships, licenses and procurement for the operations estate.Requirements------------**Who You Are**We are looking for an operations leader, not an architect. Technical depth matters, and so does the ability to run a team through a platform transition without dropping the service underneath it.* You keep the service running while the ground moves. A platform transition does not become the customer's problem.* You lead through presence and clarity, not authority. Your team knows what good looks like.* You are calm in an incident and precise afterwards. The postmortem produces a fix, not a narrative.* You treat the service desk as part of the product, not as a queue to be absorbed.* You tell your manager what is broken and what you need to fix it.**Must Haves*** **Leadership:** 5\+ years leading IT operations, in a cloud, hosting or service provider environment.* **VMware:** hands\-on experience in production. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Account Manager--- Senior Account Manager======================Welcome to **Xelon** – where technology meets innovation and customer centricity.As we continue to expand, we are looking for a motivated and customer\-focused**Senior Account Manager (100%)**to join our team. In this role, you will be the key link between our customers and our technical teams, ensuring long\-term partnerships and outstanding customer satisfaction.At **Xelon**, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From **IaaS** to **SaaS**, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like **technology**, **finance, insurance, and public services**. Our solutions \- **Xelon Cloud**, **Xelon Secure\+** and **Xelon HQ** combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one are on a mission to become the **\#1 Swiss Cloud Enabler**, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.Tasks-----**Your role and your responsibilities**The Senior Account Manager role is responsible for the acquisition of new customers, as well as growth, retention, and strategic development of existing/assigned customer accounts while ensuring a seamless and value\-driven customer experience. You are familiar with terms such as IaaS, PaaS, public and private cloud, VMs, backup, storage, containers and related topics.* **Drive \& Ownership:** You are a self\-starter who likes to take matters into your own hand, take responsibility, and persistently work toward results.* **Matching education:** Bachelor’s degree (or comparable) in Information Systems, Business, Marketing, or a related field.* **(Swiss) \& English:** You speak both and English fluently and you are able to communicate confidently and flawlessly in both – in spoken and in written form. Going the extra\-mile for your customers comes naturally to you.* **Collaborative Team Player:** You thrive in cross\-functional environments, working seamlessly with internal and external stakeholders to drive business outcomes.* **CRM Pro:** You are experience in working with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot).* **Results orientated mindset:** Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.**Nice\-to\-haves*** **Entrepreneurial Spirit:** You are characterized by a self\-motivated drive to explore new opportunities, a willingness to take initiative as well as to seek and provide solutions and a strong commitment to contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.*  **Management Ambition:** The ambition to develop into a sales management role is seen as a plus. If all goes according to plan, Xelon just might offer you that opportunity once the time is right.* **Swiss and other additional Languages:** Any language additional to the required ones is considered a plus; Swiss is an asset in this role.* **HubSpot**: Any previous hands\-on experience and/or certification for HubSpot is valuable for this role.* **AI\-mindset**: Curiosity and openness towards AI\-supported workflows, along with a solid understanding of current AI developments and tools, and a willingness to leverage them to improve efficiency and outcomes.* **A feel for processes:** You contribute ideas on how we can further optimize our sales and marketing processes.Benefits--------* **Rewarding compensation:** Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives tied to growth and sales success.* **Creative freedom:** The opportunity to make a decisive contribution to the growth of a well\-established tech scale\-up.* **Flexible working hours \& remote options:** Work when and where you are most productive.* **Innovative environment:** Experience the dynamics of a tech scale\-up with a strong existing customer base.
